title.zh: 卷一百七十七 志第一百三十 食貨上五
title.raw: 卷一百七十七 志第一百三十 食貨上五 Volume 177 Treatises 130: Finance and Economics 1e

sentences.zh: 食貨上五

translations.literal: Finance and Economics, Part 5
translations.idiomatic: Finance and Economics, Part 5

sentences.zh: （役法上）〉

translations.literal: (Corvée Labor Law, Part 1)
translations.idiomatic: (Corvée Labor Law, Part 1)

sentences.zh: 役法役出於民，州縣皆有常數。

translations.literal: Corvée labor issues from the people; every prefecture and county has fixed quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Labor service is levied upon the people, and every prefecture and county maintains fixed quotas.

sentences.zh: 宋因前代之制，以衙前主官物，以里正、戶長、鄉書手課督賦稅，以耆長、弓手、壯丁逐捕盜賊，以承符、人力、手力、散從官給使令；

translations.literal: Song adopted the systems of earlier dynasties: yamen runners were put in charge of official goods; village heads, household heads, and township clerks collected and supervised tax levies; elders, archers, and stalwart youth pursued and captured bandits; and commission bearers, laborers, hand laborers, and miscellaneous attendants were assigned to carry out orders;
translations.idiomatic: The Song followed earlier dynastic practice. Yamen-runner households managed official goods. Village heads, household heads, and township clerks collected and oversaw taxes. Elders, archers, and able-bodied men hunted down bandits. Commission bearers, hired laborers, hand laborers, and miscellaneous attendants were detailed to carry out official errands.

sentences.zh: 縣曹司至押、錄，州曹司至孔目官，下至雜職、虞候、揀、掏等人，各以鄉戶等第定差。

translations.literal: From county office clerks down to detention officers and record keepers, from prefectural office clerks down to senior clerks, down to miscellaneous posts, night watchmen, pickers, and porters, each assignment was determined by township household register grade.
translations.idiomatic: Assignments ran from county clerks and jail wardens down to porters at the yamen, and from prefectural senior clerks down to night watchmen and litter carriers — all fixed according to the graded household registers of each township.

sentences.zh: 京百司補吏，須不礙役乃聽。

translations.literal: For filling clerical posts in the capital's hundred offices, only those not obstructed by corvée were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital's hundred offices recruited clerks, a candidate could serve only if corvée obligations did not block him.

sentences.zh: 建隆中，詔文武官、內諸司、台省、寺監、諸軍、諸使，不得占州縣課役戶，州縣不得役道路居民為遞夫。

translations.literal: In the Jianlong era, an edict stated that civil and military officials, inner palace offices, the Secretariat and Chancellery, directorates and commissions, all armies and commissioners, must not occupy prefecture and county tax-paying households in corvée registers; prefectures and counties must not employ roadside residents as relay runners.
translations.idiomatic: During Jianlong, the throne forbade civil and military officials, inner offices, the Secretariat, directorates, armies, and commissioners from claiming corvée households in the prefectures, and forbade counties from drafting travelers along the highways as courier bearers.

sentences.zh: 後又詔諸州職官不得私占役戶供課。

translations.literal: Later another edict said prefectural officials might not privately occupy corvée households to supply their lessons.
translations.idiomatic: A later edict also barred prefectural officials from keeping corvée households privately to furnish their coursework.

sentences.zh: 京西轉運使程能請定諸州戶為九等，著於籍，上四等量輕重給役，餘五等免之，後有貧富，隨時升降。

translations.literal: Transport Commissioner Cheng Neng of the Capital West Circuit requested fixing all prefecture households into nine grades, entered in registers, with the upper four grades receiving corvée according to light and heavy burdens and the remaining five grades exempt, later according to wealth and poverty to be promoted or demoted at any time.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Neng, transport commissioner for the Capital West Circuit, proposed grading every prefecture household into nine ranks on the register. The top four would bear corvée in proportion to their wealth; the bottom five would be exempt, with promotion and demotion adjusted as fortunes rose or fell.

sentences.zh: 詔加裁定。

translations.literal: An edict ordered further deliberation and fixing.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the proposal reviewed and finalized.

sentences.zh: 淳化五年，始令諸縣以第一等戶為里正，第二等戶為戶長，勿冒名以給役。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chunhua, it was first ordered that all counties use first-grade households as village heads and second-grade households as household heads, and not use false names to supply corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 5, counties were first required to appoint first-rank households as village heads and second-rank households as household heads, and forbidden to supply corvée under borrowed names.

sentences.zh: 自餘眾役，多調廂軍。

translations.literal: For the remaining multitude of corvée duties, garrison militia were mostly mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Most other labor duties were shifted to the garrison militia.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，提點刑獄府界段惟幾發中牟縣夫二百修馬監倉。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Judicial Intendant for the Capital Circuit Duan Weiji mobilized two hundred corvée laborers from Zhongmou County to repair the horse-pasture granary.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 5, Duan Weiji, judicial intendant for the capital circuit, drafted two hundred laborers from Zhongmou County to repair the horse-pasture granary.

sentences.zh: 群牧製置使代以廄卒，因下詔禁之。

translations.literal: The Pasturage Commissioner replaced them with stable grooms, and on this account an edict forbade the practice.
translations.idiomatic: The Pasturage Commissioner substituted stable grooms instead, and the throne issued an edict banning such drafts.

sentences.zh: 惟詔令有大興作而後調丁夫。

translations.literal: Only when edicts ordered major construction were corvée laborers mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée laborers were called up only when an edict mandated a major public works project.

sentences.zh: 然役有輕重勞佚之不齊，人有貧富強弱之不一，承平既久，奸偽滋生。

translations.literal: Yet corvée had uneven light and heavy burdens and uneven labor and rest; people had uneven wealth, poverty, strength, and weakness; after long peace, fraud and falsification proliferated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet duties varied in severity, and households varied in wealth and strength. After decades of peace, fraud flourished.

sentences.zh: 命官、形勢占田無限，皆得復役，衙前將吏得免里正、戶長；

translations.literal: Appointed officials and powerful local families occupied land without limit, all could be restored to corvée exemption, and yamen-runner clerks and officers could be exempted from village head and household head duties;
translations.idiomatic: Officials and local powerholders held unlimited land yet claimed exemption from corvée, while yamen-runner clerks and officers were excused from serving as village or household heads;

sentences.zh: 而應役之戶，困於繁數，偽為券售田於形勢之家，假佃戶之名，以避徭役。

translations.literal: But households that should serve corvée, distressed by numerous assignments, falsely made deeds selling fields to powerful families, borrowing tenant names to avoid corvée.
translations.idiomatic: while households liable for service, crushed by endless assignments, forged deeds selling land to powerful families and posed as tenants to escape corvée.

sentences.zh: 乾興初，始立限田法，形勢敢挾他戶田者聽人告，子所挾田三之一。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianxing, the limited-land law was first established: if powerful families dared to seize other households' fields, people were permitted to report them, and they would forfeit one-third of the seized fields.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianxing, a limited-land law was enacted: anyone who seized another household's land could be reported, and the offender forfeited one-third of the land he had taken.

sentences.zh: 時州縣既廣，徭役益眾，太常博士範諷知廣濟軍，因言：「軍地方四十里，戶口不及一縣，而徭差與諸郡等，願復為縣。」

translations.literal: At that time prefectures and counties had already expanded and corvée duties had grown numerous. Erudite of the Imperial Sacrifices Fan Feng, as magistrate of Guangji Army, therefore said: "The army district is only forty li in area, its registered population not equal to one county, yet its corvée assignments equal those of other prefectures. We wish to be restored to county status."
translations.idiomatic: By then prefectures and counties had multiplied and corvée burdens had grown. Fan Feng, an Erudite of the Imperial Sacrifices serving as magistrate of Guangji Army, petitioned: "Our district covers only forty li and has fewer households than a single county, yet our corvée assignments match those of full prefectures. We ask to be reduced again to county status."

sentences.zh: 轉運司執不可，因詔裁損役人。

translations.literal: The transport office insisted it could not be done, and on this account an edict ordered reduction of corvée personnel.
translations.idiomatic: The transport commissioner refused, but the throne ordered corvée quotas cut instead.

sentences.zh: 自是數下詔書，督州縣長吏與轉運使議蠲冗役，以寬民力。

translations.literal: From this time edicts were repeatedly issued, urging prefecture and county chief officials together with transport commissioners to discuss abolishing redundant corvée, to ease the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter edicts repeatedly urged prefectural and county leaders, together with transport commissioners, to abolish redundant corvée and ease the people's burdens.

sentences.zh: 又令州縣錄丁產及所產役使，前期揭示，不實者民得自言。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that prefectures and counties record adult males' property and the corvée assignments produced from that property, disclose them in advance, and if not accurate the people might speak for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were also required to register each household's property and corvée obligations, post the lists in advance, and allow the people to challenge false entries.

sentences.zh: 役之重者，自里正、鄉戶為衙前，主典府庫或輦運官物，往往破產。

translations.literal: Among heavy corvée duties, from village head and township household service as yamen runner, managing prefectural granaries or transporting official goods by cart, bankruptcy often resulted.
translations.idiomatic: The heaviest duties — village head, household head, and especially yamen-runner service managing granaries or hauling official goods — often drove families to ruin.

sentences.zh: 景祐中，稍欲寬其法，乃命募人充役。

translations.literal: In the Jingyou era, wishing slightly to ease the law, they ordered recruiting people to fill corvée.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingyou the court sought modest relief and allowed corvée to be filled by hired substitutes.

sentences.zh: 初，官八品以下死者，子孫役同編戶；

translations.literal: Initially, when officials of the eighth rank and below died, their descendants' corvée was the same as registered households;
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when an official of eighth rank or below died, his descendants bore corvée like ordinary registered households;

sentences.zh: 至是，詔特蠲之。

translations.literal: At this time an edict specially exempted them.
translations.idiomatic: now an edict specially exempted them.

sentences.zh: 民避役者，或竄名浮圖籍，號為出家，趙州至千餘人，詔出家者須落發為僧，乃聽免役。

translations.literal: People avoiding corvée sometimes hid their names in Buddhist registers, calling it leaving home; in Zhao Prefecture there were more than a thousand. An edict said those leaving home must shave their heads and become monks before corvée exemption was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: To evade corvée, some households entered their names on Buddhist rolls and claimed to have "left home"; Zhao Prefecture alone had more than a thousand such cases. An edict required them actually to shave their heads and become monks before exemption would be granted.

sentences.zh: 禁諸縣非捕盜毋擅役壯丁。

translations.literal: All counties were forbidden, unless capturing bandits, to employ stalwart youth on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Counties were forbidden to draft able-bodied men except for bandit suppression.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，令京東西、河北、陝西、河東裁損役人，即給使不足，益以廂兵。

translations.literal: In the Qingli era, the Capital East and West, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong circuits were ordered to reduce corvée personnel; where assignments were insufficient, garrison militia were added.
translations.idiomatic: During Qingli, the eastern and western capital circuits, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong were ordered to cut corvée quotas; where labor still fell short, garrison militia were added.

sentences.zh: 既而詔諸路轉運司條析州縣差徭賦斂之數，委二府大臣裁減，科役不均，以鄉村、坊郭戶均差。

translations.literal: Soon after an edict ordered transport offices of all circuits to itemize prefecture and county corvée assignments and tax collections, entrusting Two Departments grandees to reduce them; where corvée levies were uneven, rural and urban ward households were to be assigned evenly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then required every transport commissioner to itemize corvée and tax levies in his circuit and submit them to grandees of the Two Departments for reduction. Uneven assignments were to be equalized across rural and urban households.

sentences.zh: 時范仲淹執政，謂天下縣多，故役蕃而民瘠，首廢河南諸縣，欲以次及他州。

translations.literal: At that time Fan Zhongyan held power and said that because counties throughout the realm were numerous, corvée was heavy and the people lean; he first abolished several counties in Henan and wished to extend this in order to other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan, then in power, argued that the empire had too many counties, multiplying corvée and impoverishing the people. He began by abolishing several counties in Henan and hoped to extend the policy elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 當時以為非，未幾悉復。

translations.literal: At the time this was considered wrong, and before long all were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Critics deemed the move misguided, and within a short time every county was restored.

sentences.zh: 王逵為荊湖轉運使，率民輸錢免役，得緡錢三十萬，進為羨餘，蒙詔獎。

translations.literal: Wang Kui as Jinghu transport commissioner led the people to pay money to buy out corvée, obtaining three hundred thousand strings of cash, presented as surplus revenue, and received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kui, transport commissioner for Jinghu, collected cash from the people in lieu of corvée, turned in three hundred thousand strings as surplus revenue, and received an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 繇是他路競為掊克以市恩。

translations.literal: Hence other circuits competed to extort in order to curry favor.
translations.idiomatic: Other circuits then competed to squeeze the people in order to win favor at court.

sentences.zh: 皇祐中，詔州縣里正、押司、錄事既代而令輸錢免役者，論如違制律。

translations.literal: In Huangyou, an edict said that when prefectures and counties, after village heads, bailiffs, and recorders had completed their terms, ordered them to pay money to buy out corvée, they were to be prosecuted under the statute on violating imperial regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou, an edict declared that any prefecture or county that, after a village head, bailiff, or recorder had finished his term, accepted cash to excuse him from further service would be prosecuted for violating imperial regulations.

sentences.zh: 又禁役鄉戶為長名衙前。

translations.literal: It was also forbidden to assign township households to permanent-name yamen-runner duty.
translations.idiomatic: The court also forbade assigning township households to standing yamen-runner posts.

sentences.zh: 初，知并州韓琦上疏曰：「州縣生民之苦，無重於里正衙前。

translations.literal: Initially, Bingzhou Prefect Han Qi submitted a memorial saying: "Among the sufferings of the living people in prefectures and counties, none is heavier than village head and yamen-runner duty.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Han Qi, prefect of Bingzhou, memorialized: "No burden on the people in prefecture and county is heavier than service as village head or yamen runner.

sentences.zh: 有孀母改嫁，親族分居；

translations.literal: Some have widowed mothers remarry and relatives divide households;
translations.idiomatic: Some have widows remarry and kin divide their households;

sentences.zh: 或棄田與人，以免上等；

translations.literal: some abandon fields to others to avoid top-grade assignment;
translations.idiomatic: others will abandon fields to escape top-rank classification;

sentences.zh: 或非命求死，以就單丁。

translations.literal: some seek untimely death to achieve single-adult-male status.
translations.idiomatic: still others court death to leave only a single adult male in the household.

sentences.zh: 規圖百端，苟免溝壑之患。

translations.literal: They scheme in a hundred ways, wishing only to escape the calamity of the ditch.
translations.idiomatic: They contrive every imaginable scheme merely to avoid ruin.

sentences.zh: 每鄉被差疏密，與資力高下不均。

translations.literal: In each township the density of assignments and the high and low of assets and strength are uneven.
translations.idiomatic: Assignment density varies from township to township, as does the distribution of wealth.

sentences.zh: 假有一縣甲乙二鄉，甲鄉第一等戶十五戶，計資為錢三百萬，乙鄉第一等戶五戶，計貲為錢五十萬；

translations.literal: Suppose in one county there are Townships A and B: Township A has fifteen first-grade households, assets totaling three million cash; Township B has five first-grade households, assets totaling five hundred thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: Suppose one county has Townships A and B. Township A has fifteen first-rank households worth three million cash in all; Township B has five first-rank households worth five hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 番休遞役，即甲鄉十五年一周，乙鄉五年一周。

translations.literal: with rotation of rest and succession of duty, then Township A completes one cycle in fifteen years and Township B in five years.
translations.idiomatic: Under the rotation system, Township A would complete one full cycle in fifteen years, Township B in only five.

sentences.zh: 富者休息有餘，貧者敗亡相繼，豈朝廷為民父母意乎？

translations.literal: The wealthy rest with surplus, the poor fail and perish in succession — is this the court's intent as parent of the people?
translations.idiomatic: The wealthy enjoy long reprieves while the poor are ruined in succession. Is this how the court acts as parent to the people?

sentences.zh: 請罷里正衙前，命轉運司以州軍見役人數為額，令、佐視五等簿，通一縣計之，籍皆在第一等，選資最高者一戶為鄉戶衙前，後差人放此。

translations.literal: I request abolishing village head and yamen-runner duties, ordering transport offices to take the army-district's current corvée personnel as quota, magistrates and assistants viewing the five-grade register, calculating through the whole county, all registers being in the first grade, selecting the one household of highest assets as township yamen runner, later assignments following this.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that village head and yamen-runner duties be abolished. Let transport commissioners set quotas from current corvée rolls. Magistrates and assistants should review the five-grade register for the whole county, list only first-rank households, and select the wealthiest as township yamen runner, with later assignments following the same rule.

sentences.zh: 即甲縣戶少而役蕃，聽差乙縣戶多而役簡者。

translations.literal: If County A has few households but heavy corvée, permit assigning from County B, which has many households but light corvée.
translations.idiomatic: If one county has few households but heavy corvée, households from a neighboring county with many households but lighter duties may be assigned.

sentences.zh: 簿書未盡實，聽換取他戶。

translations.literal: If registers are not fully accurate, permit substituting another household.
translations.idiomatic: If the register is inaccurate, another household may be substituted.

sentences.zh: 里正主督租賦，請以戶長代之，二年一易。」

translations.literal: Village heads supervise tax collection; I request household heads replace them, changing every two years."
translations.idiomatic: Village heads now supervise tax collection; let household heads replace them on a two-year rotation."

sentences.zh: 下其議京畿、河北、河東、陝西、京東西轉運司度利害，皆以為便。

translations.literal: The proposal was sent down to transport offices of the Capital Circuit, Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, and Capital East and West to assess benefit and harm; all considered it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was referred to transport commissioners in the capital circuit, Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, and the eastern and western capital circuits; all reported it would be beneficial.

sentences.zh: 而知制誥韓絳、蔡襄極論江南、福建里正衙前之弊，絳請行鄉戶五則之法，襄請以產錢多少定役重輕。

translations.literal: But Han Jiang and Cai Xiang, Drafters of Edicts, argued at length the abuses of village head and yamen-runner duty in Jiangnan and Fujian; Jiang requested implementing the township five-category method, Xiang requested determining corvée light and heavy by amount of property tax.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jiang and Cai Xiang, drafters of edicts, meanwhile detailed the abuses of village head and yamen-runner duty in Jiangnan and Fujian. Jiang proposed the five-category township method; Xiang proposed scaling corvée by property-tax liability.

sentences.zh: 至和中，命絳、襄與三司置司參定，繼遣尚書都官員外郎吳幾復趨江東，殿中丞蔡稟趨江西，與長吏、轉運使議可否。

translations.literal: In Zhihe, Jiang and Xiang were ordered together with the Three Departments to establish an office for joint deliberation; subsequently Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Wu Jifu was sent to hurry to Jiangdong, and Palace Remonstrance Bureau Aide Cai Bing to hurry to Jiangxi, to discuss feasibility with chief officials and transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe, Jiang and Xiang were ordered, together with the Three Departments, to establish a review office. Wu Jifu of the Ministry of Revenue was sent to Jiangdong and Cai Bing to Jiangxi to consult local officials and transport commissioners.

sentences.zh: 因請行五則法，凡差鄉戶衙前，視資產多寡置籍，分為五則，又第其役輕重放此。

translations.literal: They therefore requested implementing the five-category method: whenever assigning township yamen runners, according to more or less assets establish registers, divided into five categories, and likewise rank corvée light and heavy following this.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed the five-category method: for every township yamen-runner assignment, households would be registered in five categories according to wealth, and corvée duties ranked by severity in the same way.

sentences.zh: 假有第一等重役十，當役十人，列第一等戶百；

translations.literal: Suppose there are ten heavy duties of the first grade requiring ten men to serve; list one hundred first-grade households;
translations.idiomatic: Suppose ten heavy first-grade duties each require one man: register one hundred first-grade households;

sentences.zh: 第二等重役五，當役五人，列第二等戶五十，以備十番役使。

translations.literal: five heavy duties of the second grade requiring five men, list fifty second-grade households, to provide for ten rotations of service.
translations.idiomatic: five heavy second-grade duties requiring five men: register fifty second-grade households, enough for ten rotations.

sentences.zh: 藏其籍通判治所，遇差人，長吏以下同按視之，轉運使、提點刑獄察其違慢。

translations.literal: Store the registers at the vice-prefect's office; when assigning personnel, the chief official and below jointly inspect them; transport commissioners and judicial intendants investigate delays and negligence.
translations.idiomatic: Registers were kept at the vice-prefect's office. Assignments were made jointly by the magistrate and his staff; transport commissioners and judicial intendants monitored delays and abuse.

sentences.zh: 遂更著淮南、江南、兩浙、荊湖、福建之法，下三司頒焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon regulations for Huainan, Jiangnan, the two Zhe circuits, Jinghu, and Fujian were revised and issued by the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Revised regulations for Huainan, Jiangnan, the two Zhe circuits, Jinghu, and Fujian were then promulgated through the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 自罷里正衙前，民稍休息。

translations.literal: From the time village head and yamen-runner duties were abolished, the people rested somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: After village head and yamen-runner duties were abolished, the people gained some relief.

sentences.zh: 又詔諸路轉運司、開封府界訪衙前之役有重為害者條奏之；

translations.literal: Another edict ordered transport offices of all circuits and the Kaifeng prefectural boundary to investigate yamen-runner duties that were heavy and harmful and memorialize them item by item;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered transport commissioners and the Kaifeng metropolitan district to report any yamen-runner duties that were especially burdensome;

sentences.zh: 能件悉便利、大去勞弊者議賞。

translations.literal: those able to itemize fully what was convenient and greatly remove labor and abuse were to be considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: and to recommend rewards for officials who could itemize practical reforms and greatly reduce abuse.

sentences.zh: 置寬恤民力司，遣使四出。

translations.literal: An office to ease and comfort the people's strength was established, and envoys were sent out in four directions.
translations.idiomatic: A Bureau to Relieve the People's Burdens was established, and envoys were dispatched throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 自是州縣力役多所裁損，凡二萬三千六百二十二人。

translations.literal: From this time prefecture and county labor corvée was largely reduced, totaling twenty-three thousand six hundred twenty-two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter prefectures and counties cut corvée assignments by twenty-three thousand six hundred twenty-two persons in all.

sentences.zh: 治平四年，詔曰：「農，天下之大本也。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiping, an edict said: "Agriculture is the great foundation of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiping 4, an edict declared: "Agriculture is the foundation of the realm.

sentences.zh: 間因水旱，頗致流離，殆州郡差役之法甚煩，其詔中外臣庶條陳利害以聞。」

translations.literal: Occasionally because of flood and drought, considerable displacement has resulted; perhaps the methods of corvée assignment in prefectures and commanderies are very troublesome — let it be ordered that civil and military officials inside and outside memorialize benefit and harm item by item to inform Us."
translations.idiomatic: Floods and droughts have lately driven many from their homes, perhaps because corvée assignment in the prefectures has grown too burdensome. Let officials at court and in the provinces submit detailed proposals on the benefits and harms of reform."

sentences.zh: 先是，三司使韓絳言：「聞京東民有父子二丁將為衙前役者，其父告其子曰『吾當求死，使汝曹免於凍餒』，遂自縊而死。

translations.literal: Earlier, Three Departments Commissioner Han Jiang said: "I have heard that in the Capital East Circuit there were a father and son, two adult males, about to serve yamen-runner duty. The father told his son, 'I shall seek death so that you may be spared from freezing and hunger,' and thereupon hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Han Jiang, commissioner of the Three Departments, reported: "In the eastern capital circuit a father and son, both adult males, were about to be assigned yamen-runner duty. The father told his sons, 'I shall seek death so that you may escape hunger and cold,' and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 又聞江南有嫁其祖母及與母析居以避役者，又有鬻田減其戶等者。

translations.literal: I have also heard that in Jiangnan some married off their grandmothers and divided households with their mothers to avoid corvée, and some sold fields to lower their household grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangnan, I am told, some men married off grandmothers or split households with their mothers to evade corvée; others sold land to lower their household rank.

sentences.zh: 田歸官戶不役之家，而役並於同等見存之戶。

translations.literal: Fields returned to official households and families exempt from corvée, while corvée was combined upon remaining households of the same grade.
translations.idiomatic: The land passed to official households exempt from corvée, while the corvée burden fell entirely on the remaining households of the same rank.

sentences.zh: 望博訪利害，集議裁定，使力役無偏重之寄。」

translations.literal: I hope broadly to investigate benefit and harm, gather deliberation to decide and fix, so that labor corvée has no leaning of excessive burden."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that benefit and harm be thoroughly investigated, deliberated, and settled so that labor duties no longer fall with crushing weight on a few."

sentences.zh: 役法更議始此。

translations.literal: The renewed deliberation on corvée law began from this.
translations.idiomatic: This was the beginning of the renewed debate over corvée law.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年，知諫院吳充言：「今鄉役之中，衙前為重。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, Remonstrance Bureau Director Wu Chong said: "Among township corvée duties today, yamen-runner duty is the heaviest.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 1, Wu Chong, director of the Remonstrance Bureau, said: "Among township corvée duties today, yamen-runner service is the heaviest burden.

sentences.zh: 民間規避重役，土地不敢多耕，而避戶等；

translations.literal: Among the people schemes to avoid heavy corvée abound; they dare not cultivate much land and avoid household grades;
translations.idiomatic: To escape heavy duties, people dare not cultivate all their land and scheme to lower their household rank;

sentences.zh: 骨肉不敢義聚，而憚人丁。

translations.literal: kin dare not gather in righteous community and fear adult males.
translations.idiomatic: relatives dare not live together and dread adding adult males to the household.

sentences.zh: 故近年上戶浸少，中下戶浸多，役使頻仍，生資不給，則轉為工商，不得已而為盜賊。

translations.literal: Therefore in recent years upper households have gradually decreased and middle and lower households gradually increased; corvée assignments are frequent, livelihoods insufficient, then they turn to crafts and commerce, and when they have no choice become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Upper households have therefore grown fewer while middle and lower households have multiplied. Corvée assignments come in relentless succession; when livelihoods fail, people turn to trade and crafts, and in desperation become bandits.

sentences.zh: 宜早定鄉役利害，以時施行。」

translations.literal: It is fitting early to fix the benefit and harm of township corvée and implement it in season."
translations.idiomatic: Township corvée should be reformed promptly and put into effect without delay."

sentences.zh: 後帝閱內藏庫奏，有衙前越千里輸金七錢，庫吏邀乞，逾年不得還者。

translations.literal: Later the emperor reviewed Inner Treasury memorials and found a yamen runner who transported seven cash of gold more than a thousand li; treasury clerks detained and begged from him, and for more than a year he could not return.
translations.idiomatic: Later, reviewing memorials from the Inner Treasury, the emperor read of a yamen runner who had carried seven cash of gold more than a thousand li. Treasury clerks detained and extorted him, and for more than a year he could not return home.

sentences.zh: 帝重傷之，乃詔製置條例司講立役法。

translations.literal: The emperor was deeply grieved and thereupon ordered the Regulatory Affairs Commission to discuss establishing corvée law.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply moved, the emperor ordered the Regulatory Affairs Commission to draft a new corvée law.

sentences.zh: 二年，遣劉彝、謝卿材、侯叔獻、程顥、盧秉、王汝翼、曾伉、王廣廉八人行諸路，相度農田水利、稅賦科率、徭役利害。

translations.literal: In the second year, Liu Yi, Xie Qingcai, Hou Shuxian, Cheng Hao, Lu Bing, Wang Ruyi, Zeng Kang, and Wang Guanglian — eight persons — were sent through all circuits to survey farmland and waterworks, tax levies and collections, and the benefit and harm of corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, eight officials — Liu Yi, Xie Qingcai, Hou Shuxian, Cheng Hao, Lu Bing, Wang Ruyi, Zeng Kang, and Wang Guanglian — were dispatched through every circuit to survey farmland, waterworks, tax levies, and corvée burdens.

sentences.zh: 條例司檢詳文字蘇轍言：「役人之不可不用鄉戶，猶官吏之不可不用士人也。

translations.literal: Regulatory Affairs Commission Text Reviewer Su Zhe said: "Corvée laborers cannot fail to use township households, just as officials cannot fail to use literati.
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhe, text reviewer for the Regulatory Affairs Commission, argued: "Corvée laborers, like officials, must be drawn from local households — the one from the villages, the other from the literati.

sentences.zh: 今遂欲兩稅之外別立一科，謂之庸錢，以備官雇，不問戶之高低，例使出錢，上戶則便，下戶實難。」

translations.literal: Now they wish outside the two-tax system to establish separately one category called service money, to supply official hiring; regardless of household high or low, all are required to pay money — upper households then find it convenient, lower households truly find it hard."
translations.idiomatic: Now you propose a new levy beyond the two-tax system, called service money, to fund official hiring. Every household would pay regardless of rank. That suits the wealthy, but would crush the poor."

sentences.zh: 轍以議不合罷。

translations.literal: Zhe was dismissed because his views did not accord.
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhe was dismissed because his views did not accord with the commission's.

sentences.zh: 條例司言：「使民出泉雇役，即先王致民財以祿庶人在官者之意，願以條目遣官分行天下，博盡眾議。」

translations.literal: The Regulatory Affairs Commission said: "Having the people pay money to hire corvée labor is precisely the intent of the former kings in bringing the people's wealth to provide salaries for commoners serving in office. We wish to send officials with the regulations through the realm to gather fully all opinions."
translations.idiomatic: The Regulatory Affairs Commission argued: "Letting the people pay cash to hire corvée labor fulfills the ancient kings' intent to use the people's wealth to support those who serve the state. We ask that officials carry these regulations throughout the realm and gather every opinion."

sentences.zh: 於是條諭諸路曰：「衙前既用重難分數，凡買撲酒稅坊場，舊以酬衙前者，從官自賣，以其錢同役錢隨分數給之。

translations.literal: Thereupon regulations instructed all circuits: "Since yamen runners are now assigned by heavy-and-light difficulty shares, all wine-tax monopoly shops and market stalls formerly used to compensate yamen runners shall be sold by officials themselves, and the money together with corvée money shall be distributed according to shares.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were then issued to every circuit: "Yamen runners will be ranked by the severity of their duties. Wine-tax franchises and market stalls formerly granted as compensation to yamen runners will be sold by the government, and the proceeds, together with corvée funds, distributed by rank.

sentences.zh: 其廂鎮場務之類，舊酬獎衙前、不可令民買占者，即用舊定分數為投名衙前酬獎。

translations.literal: For garrison-town market offices and the like, formerly rewarding yamen runners and not permitted to be bought and occupied by the people, use the old fixed shares as rewards for registered-name yamen runners.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison-town market offices and similar posts that formerly rewarded yamen runners but could not be privately purchased will continue to serve as compensation for registered yamen runners at the old fixed rates.

sentences.zh: 如部水陸運及領倉驛、場務、公使庫之類，其舊煩擾且使陪備者，今當省使毋費。

translations.literal: Such as supervising water and land transport and managing granaries, post stations, market offices, and public envoy storehouses — those formerly troublesome and requiring runners to make good losses — now shall be streamlined so runners need not pay out of pocket.
translations.idiomatic: Duties such as supervising water and land transport, managing granaries, post stations, market offices, and public envoy storehouses — formerly burdensome and requiring runners to cover losses — will be streamlined so runners need not pay out of pocket.

sentences.zh: 承符、散從官等舊苦重役償欠者，今當改法除弊，庶使無困。

translations.literal: Commission bearers, miscellaneous attendants, and the like who formerly suffered from heavy corvée and repaying debts — now the law shall be changed to remove abuses, so that hopefully they will not be distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Commission bearers and miscellaneous attendants who formerly suffered under heavy corvée and debt repayment will be relieved by revised regulations.

sentences.zh: 凡有產業物力而舊無役者，今當出泉以助役。」

translations.literal: All who have property and assets but formerly had no corvée shall now pay money to assist corvée."
translations.idiomatic: Households with property who formerly bore no corvée must now contribute cash toward hiring labor."

sentences.zh: 久之，司農寺言：「今立役條，所寬優者，皆村鄉樸蠢不能自達之窮氓；

translations.literal: After some time the Ministry of Agriculture said: "The corvée regulations now established benefit chiefly the simple and dull poor of villages and townships who cannot speak for themselves;
translations.idiomatic: After some time the Ministry of Agriculture observed: "The new corvée regulations chiefly benefit the simple poor of the villages who cannot speak for themselves;

sentences.zh: 所裁取者，乃仕宦兼並能致人言之豪右。

translations.literal: those cut back are the powerful right families of officials and great landholders who can make others speak for them.
translations.idiomatic: while those who lose privilege are the powerful officials and great landholders who can make their voices heard at court.

sentences.zh: 若經制一定，則衙司縣吏無以施誅求巧舞之奸，故新法之行尤所不便。

translations.literal: If the regulations are fixed, yamen clerks and county clerks will have no means to apply extortion and crafty manipulation — therefore the new law's implementation is especially inconvenient to them.
translations.idiomatic: Once the regulations are fixed, yamen and county clerks will no longer be able to extort and manipulate assignments — which is why they resist the new law most fiercely.

sentences.zh: 欲先自一兩州為始，候其成就，即令諸州軍仿視施行，若實便百姓，當特獎之。」

translations.literal: We wish first to begin in one or two prefectures; wait until success is achieved, then order all army districts to imitate and implement; if it truly benefits the common people, special rewards should be given."
translations.idiomatic: We propose to begin in one or two prefectures. Once the results are clear, other districts may follow. Officials who truly benefit the people should receive special rewards."

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 於是提點府界公事趙子幾奏上府界所在條目，下之司農，詔判寺鄧綰、曾布更議之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Judicial Intendant for Metropolitan Affairs Zhao Ziji memorialized submitting the regulations for the metropolitan boundary, sent down to the Ministry of Agriculture; an edict ordered Ministry judges Deng Guan and Zeng Bu to deliberate further.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ziji, judicial intendant for metropolitan affairs, then submitted regulations for the capital district. The Ministry of Agriculture received them, and Deng Guan and Zeng Bu were ordered to revise the plan.

sentences.zh: 綰、布言：「畿內鄉戶，計產業若家資之貧富，上下分為五等。

translations.literal: Guan and Bu said: "For township households within the capital region, calculating the wealth or poverty of property and household assets, divide them into five grades above and below.
translations.idiomatic: Guan and Bu proposed: "Within the capital region, township households should be ranked in five grades according to property and household wealth.

sentences.zh: 歲以夏秋隨等輸錢，鄉戶自四等、坊郭自六等以下勿輸。

translations.literal: Each year in summer and autumn pay money according to grade; township households from the fourth grade down and urban ward households from the sixth grade down need not pay.
translations.idiomatic: Each year they would pay in summer and autumn according to rank. Township households below the fourth grade and urban households below the sixth grade would be exempt.

sentences.zh: 兩縣有產業者，上等各隨縣，中等並一縣輸。

translations.literal: Those with property spanning two counties: upper grades each follow their county; middle grades combine payment in one county.
translations.idiomatic: Households with property in two counties would pay as upper-grade households in each county, but middle-grade households in a single county only.

sentences.zh: 析居者隨所析而定、降其等。

translations.literal: Those dividing households follow where the division is fixed and lower their grade.
translations.idiomatic: Households that split would be ranked according to the divided property and their grade lowered accordingly.

sentences.zh: 若官戶、女戶、寺觀、未成丁，減半輸。

translations.literal: Official households, female-headed households, temples, and those not yet adult males pay half.
translations.idiomatic: Official households, female-headed households, temples, and minors would pay half the standard rate.

sentences.zh: 皆用其錢募三等以上稅戶代役，隨役重輕制祿。

translations.literal: All use this money to recruit tax-paying households of the third grade and above to substitute for corvée, setting salaries according to corvée light and heavy.
translations.idiomatic: The funds would hire third-grade and higher tax-paying households to perform corvée in their place, with compensation scaled to the severity of each duty.

sentences.zh: 開封縣戶二萬二千六百有奇，歲輸錢萬二千九百緡。

translations.literal: Kaifeng County had more than twenty-two thousand six hundred households, paying yearly twelve thousand nine hundred strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng County had more than 22,600 households, paying 12,900 strings of cash per year.

sentences.zh: 以萬二百為祿，贏其二千七百，以備凶荒欠閣，他縣仿此。」

translations.literal: Ten thousand two hundred were used as salaries, the surplus of two thousand seven hundred reserved against flood, drought, and arrears; other counties followed this model."
translations.idiomatic: 10,200 strings funded salaries; the remaining 2,700 were held in reserve against flood, drought, and arrears. Other counties followed the same pattern."

sentences.zh: 然輸錢計等高下，而戶等著籍，昔緣巧避失實。

translations.literal: Yet payment was calculated by grade high and low, while household grades were entered in registers; formerly because of crafty evasion they had not reflected reality.
translations.idiomatic: Yet payments depended on household rank, and the registers had long been distorted by evasion.

sentences.zh: 乃詔責郡縣，坊郭三年，鄉村五年，農隙集眾，稽其物產，考其貧富，察其詐偽，為之升降；

translations.literal: An edict therefore charged prefectures and counties: urban wards every three years, villages every five years, in agricultural slack seasons gather the multitude, examine their property, assess their wealth and poverty, investigate fraud and falsification, and promote or demote them;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered prefectures and counties to reassess ranks every three years in urban wards and every five years in villages. During the agricultural off-season they were to assemble the people, audit property, weigh wealth and poverty, detect fraud, and adjust ranks accordingly;

sentences.zh: 若故為高下者，以違制論。

translations.literal: if anyone deliberately manipulated grades high or low, prosecute under the statute on violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: anyone who deliberately manipulated ranks would be prosecuted for violating imperial regulations.

sentences.zh: 募法：三人相任，衙前仍供物產為抵；

translations.literal: Recruitment method: three persons mutually guarantee one another; yamen runners still supply property as security;
translations.idiomatic: Recruitment rules: three men would guarantee one another; yamen runners still posted property as security;

sentences.zh: 弓手試武藝，典吏試書計；

translations.literal: archers were tested in martial arts, clerks in writing and reckoning;
translations.idiomatic: archers were tested in martial skill and clerks in writing and accounts;

sentences.zh: 以三年或二年乃更。

translations.literal: after three or two years they would be replaced.
translations.idiomatic: terms ran two or three years before rotation.

sentences.zh: 為法既具，揭示一月，民無異辭，著為令。

translations.literal: When the law was complete, it was posted for one month; the people had no objections, and it was enacted as statute.
translations.idiomatic: When the regulations were complete, they were posted for a month. The people raised no objections, and the rules were promulgated as law.

sentences.zh: 令下，募者執役，被差者得散去。

translations.literal: When the statute took effect, recruits performed duties and those previously assigned were released.
translations.idiomatic: Once the law took effect, hired substitutes took up duty and previously assigned households were released.

sentences.zh: 開封一府罷衙前八百三十人，畿縣鄉役數千，遂頒其法於天下。

translations.literal: In Kaifeng one prefecture abolished eight hundred thirty yamen runners; capital-region counties released thousands from township corvée; thereupon the law was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng prefecture alone released 830 yamen runners; capital counties released thousands more from township corvée. The law was then extended empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 天下土俗不同，役重輕不一，民貧富不等，從所便為法。

translations.literal: Customs differed throughout the realm, corvée heavy and light were not uniform, and the people's wealth and poverty were unequal; each place adopted what was convenient as law.
translations.idiomatic: Local customs varied across the empire, as did the severity of corvée and the distribution of wealth; each region adapted the law to local conditions.

sentences.zh: 凡當役人戶，以等第出錢，名免役錢。

translations.literal: All households liable for corvée paid money according to grade, called exemption-from-corvée money.
translations.idiomatic: Households liable for corvée paid according to rank; this levy was called the exemption-from-corvée fee.

sentences.zh: 其坊郭等第戶及未成丁、單丁、女戶、寺觀、品官之家，舊無色役而出錢者，名助役錢。

translations.literal: Urban graded households and those of minors, single adult males, female-headed households, temples, and ranked official families, who formerly had no corvée assignments but now paid money, were called assistance corvée money.
translations.idiomatic: Urban households, minors, single adult males, female-headed households, temples, and ranked official families — who formerly bore no corvée but now contributed cash — paid what was called the assistance corvée fee.

sentences.zh: 凡敷錢，先視州若縣應用雇直多少，隨戶等均取；

translations.literal: For all assessed money, first examine how much hiring wages the prefecture or county required, then collect evenly from households according to grade;
translations.idiomatic: Assessments were based first on the hiring wages each prefecture or county required, then levied evenly by household rank;

sentences.zh: 雇直既已用足，又率其數增取二分，以備水旱欠閣，雖增毋得過二分，謂之免役寬剩錢。

translations.literal: once hiring wages were fully supplied, another two-tenths of the amount was added to prepare against flood, drought, and arrears; though added, it might not exceed two-tenths, called exemption-from-corvée surplus money.
translations.idiomatic: once hiring costs were covered, an additional twenty percent was collected for reserves against flood, drought, and arrears — never exceeding twenty percent — called the exemption surplus fund.

sentences.zh: 三年，命集賢校理呂惠卿同判司農寺，已而林旦、曾布相繼典主其事。

translations.literal: In the third year, Collator of the Hall of Assembled Talents Lü Huiqing was ordered as associate judge of the Ministry of Agriculture; later Lin Dan and Zeng Bu successively directed the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In year three, Lü Huiqing of the Hall of Assembled Talents was appointed associate director of the Ministry of Agriculture; Lin Dan and Zeng Bu later succeeded him in charge of the program.

sentences.zh: 四年，罷許州衙前幹公使庫，以軍校主之，月給食錢三千。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Xu Prefecture yamen runners managing the public envoy storehouse were abolished; military officers were put in charge, given three thousand cash monthly for food.
translations.idiomatic: In year four, Xu Prefecture replaced yamen runners at the public envoy storehouse with military officers paid 3,000 cash per month for provisions.

sentences.zh: 後行於諸路，人皆便之。

translations.literal: Later it was implemented in all circuits; everyone found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The practice was later extended to every circuit and was widely welcomed.

sentences.zh: 兩浙提點刑獄王庭光、提舉常平張靚率民助役錢至七十萬。

translations.literal: Two Zhe judicial intendant Wang Tingguang and Ever-Normal Granary intendant Zhang Jing led the people to contribute assistance corvée money reaching seven hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingguang, judicial intendant for the two Zhe circuits, and Zhang Jing, Ever-Normal intendant, collected 700,000 strings in assistance corvée fees from the people.

sentences.zh: 薛向為帝言，帝問王安石，安石曰：「提舉官據數取之，朝廷以恩惠科減，於體為順。」

translations.literal: Xue Xiang spoke to the emperor; the emperor asked Wang Anshi, and Anshi said: "Intendants collected according to the figures; the court reduces by gracious favor — this accords with principle."
translations.idiomatic: When Xue Xiang reported this to the emperor, the emperor asked Wang Anshi. Anshi replied: "The intendants collected according to the assessed amounts; the court can reduce the levy as an act of grace. That is proper procedure."

sentences.zh: 御史中丞楊繪亦言：「靚等科配民輸錢，多者一戶至三百千，乞少裁損，以安民心。」

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yang Hui also said: "Jing and others apportioned money for the people to pay; in extreme cases one household reached three hundred thousand — I beg slight reduction to settle the people's hearts."
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yang Hui also urged: "Jing and others have apportioned payments so heavily that some households owe as much as 300,000 cash. I ask that the levies be trimmed to reassure the people."

sentences.zh: 五月，東明縣民數百詣開封府訴超升等第，不受，遂突入王安石私第，安石諭以相府不知；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, several hundred people of Dongming County went to Kaifeng Prefecture to complain of inflated household grades; their petition was not accepted, so they burst into Wang Anshi's private residence. Anshi told them the chief councilor's office knew nothing;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, several hundred Dongming County residents petitioned Kaifeng Prefecture against inflated household ranks. When their petition was rejected, they stormed Wang Anshi's home. Anshi told them the chief councilor's office knew nothing of the matter;

sentences.zh: 訴之御史臺，台不受訴，諭令散去。

translations.literal: they appealed to the Censorate; the Censorate did not accept the appeal and ordered them to disperse.
translations.idiomatic: they then appealed to the Censorate, which also refused the case and ordered them to disperse.

sentences.zh: 楊繪又言：「司農寺不用舊則，自據戶數創立助役錢等第，下縣令著之籍，如酸棗縣升戶等皆失實。」

translations.literal: Yang Hui again said: "The Ministry of Agriculture did not use old rules but on its own, based on household numbers, created assistance corvée money grades, sent down to counties to enter in registers — as in Zaozao County, promotions of household grade were all untrue."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hui added: "The Ministry of Agriculture ignored old rules, invented new assistance-fee ranks from raw household counts, and ordered counties to register them. In Zaozao County, for example, rank promotions were wholly fictitious."

sentences.zh: 帝乃命提點司究所從升降，仍嚴升降之法，畿民不願輸錢免役，縣按所當供役歲月，如期役之，與免輸錢。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered the intendant office to investigate the grounds for promotions and demotions, still tightening the law on promotion and demotion. Capital-region people unwilling to pay money to buy out corvée — counties according to the months when corvée should be supplied, assigned corvée on schedule, and exempted them from paying money.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the intendant office to investigate every rank change and tighten the rules. Capital-region residents who preferred corvée to cash payments could serve on the scheduled months and be exempted from the fee.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝既知東明事，及聞繪言，兩降手敕問王安石曰：「酸棗既有自下戶升入上戶，則四等有免輸役錢之名，而無其實。」

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor had already known of the Dongming affair; on hearing Hui's words he twice sent handwritten edicts asking Wang Anshi: "Since Zaozao County has lower households promoted to upper households, the fourth grade has the name of exemption from paying corvée money but not the reality."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, already aware of the Dongming affair, twice sent handwritten edicts to Wang Anshi after hearing Yang Hui: "If Zaozao County is promoting lower households to upper rank, fourth-grade households have the name of exemption without the benefit."

sentences.zh: 安石力言嘗取諸縣新舊籍對覆升降，聞外間扇搖役法者，謂輸多必有贏餘，若群訴必可免，彼既聚眾僥幸，苟受其訴，與免輸錢，當仍役之。

translations.literal: Anshi strongly said he had taken old and new registers of all counties to cross-check promotions and demotions. He heard that those outside stirring up corvée law said that if much was paid there must be surplus; if they mass-appealed they could certainly be exempted. Since they had gathered crowds hoping by chance, if their appeals were accepted and they were exempted from paying money, they should still perform corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi insisted he had cross-checked old and new registers in every county. Agitators outside court, he said, were telling people that heavy payments meant surplus funds and that mass petitions would win exemption. If the throne indulged such opportunistic crowds, they should still be required to perform corvée in person.

sentences.zh: 帝乃盡用其言。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon fully adopted his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his argument in full.

sentences.zh: 中書孫迪、張景溫體量不願出錢之民，欲困以重役，楊繪復論之。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat officials Sun Di and Zhang Jingwen investigated people unwilling to pay money and wished to distress them with heavy corvée; Yang Hui again discussed this.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Di and Zhang Jingwen of the Central Secretariat investigated residents who refused to pay cash and proposed burdening them with heavier corvée. Yang Hui protested again.

sentences.zh: 而監察御史劉摯謂：「昨者團結保甲，民方驚擾，又作法使人均出緡錢，非時升降戶等，期會急迫，人情惶駭。」

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Liu Zhi said: "Recently when organizing baojia militia the people were just alarmed and disturbed; now another law makes everyone pay strings of cash equally, promotes and demotes household grades out of season, deadlines are urgent, and popular feeling is terrified."
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Liu Zhi said: "The people were only just alarmed by the baojia militia system. Now everyone is forced to pay cash, household ranks are changed out of season, and deadlines are brutally tight. The populace is in terror."

sentences.zh: 因陳新法十害，其要曰：「上戶常少，中下戶常多，故舊法上戶之役類皆數而重，下戶之役率常簡而輕；

translations.literal: He then set forth ten harms of the new laws, the gist saying: "Upper households are always few, middle and lower always many; therefore under the old law upper households' corvée was mostly numerous and heavy, lower households' corvée mostly simple and light;
translations.idiomatic: He then listed ten harms of the new laws. In essence: "Upper households are always few and lower ones many. Under the old law, upper households bore numerous heavy duties while lower ones bore few light ones;

sentences.zh: 今不問上下戶，概視物力以差出錢，故上戶以為幸，而下戶苦之。

translations.literal: now without distinguishing upper and lower households, all are assessed by property to levy money — so upper households think themselves fortunate while lower households suffer.
translations.idiomatic: now, without regard to rank, everyone pays according to property. The wealthy consider themselves fortunate; the poor are crushed.

sentences.zh: 歲有豐凶，而役人有定數，助錢歲不可闕，則是賦稅有時減閣，而助錢更無蠲損也。

translations.literal: Years have abundance and famine, yet corvée personnel have fixed numbers and assistance money yearly cannot be lacking — thus while tax levies sometimes receive reduction and deferral, assistance money has even less exemption and reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Harvests vary, yet corvée quotas and assistance fees are fixed. Taxes may be reduced in bad years, but assistance fees are never waived.

sentences.zh: 役人必用鄉戶，為其有常產則自重，今既招雇，恐止得浮浪奸偽之人，則帑庾、場務、綱運不惟不能典幹，竊恐不勝其盜用而冒法者眾；

translations.literal: Corvée laborers must use township households because having fixed property they restrain themselves; now with recruitment, I fear only drifting and deceitful persons will be obtained — then treasuries, market offices, and transport convoys will not only fail to be managed properly; I secretly fear they cannot bear the multitude who steal and violate law;
translations.idiomatic: Corvée workers should be drawn from local households with fixed property, who restrain themselves. Hired substitutes will be drifters and frauds. Treasuries, market offices, and transport convoys will not be properly managed, and theft and lawbreaking will multiply;

sentences.zh: 至於弓手、耆、壯、承符、散從、手力、胥史之類，恐遇寇則有縱逸，因事輒為搔擾也。

translations.literal: as for archers, elders, stalwart youth, commission bearers, miscellaneous attendants, hand laborers, clerks, and the like — I fear when bandits appear they will be lax, and on any pretext will harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: as for archers, elders, stalwart youth, commission bearers, attendants, hand laborers, and clerks — they may grow lax in emergencies and harass the people at every opportunity.

sentences.zh: 司農新法，衙前不差鄉戶，其舊嘗願為長名者，聽仍其舊，卻用官自召賣酒稅坊場并州縣坊郭人戶助役錢數，酬其重難，惟此一法，有若可行；

translations.literal: Under the Ministry of Agriculture's new law, yamen runners are not assigned from township households; those who formerly wished to be permanent-name runners may continue as before, but use government sale of wine-tax franchises and urban ward households' assistance corvée money to compensate their heavy difficulty — only this one method seems perhaps feasible;
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ministry's new law, yamen runners are no longer drafted from townships; those who once held standing posts may keep them, compensated from government sale of wine franchises and urban assistance fees. Only this element seems workable;

sentences.zh: 然坊郭十等戶，緩急科率，郡縣賴之，難更使之均出助錢。

translations.literal: yet the ten grades of urban households, for urgent and routine levies, are relied on by prefectures and counties — it is hard further to make them pay assistance money equally.
translations.idiomatic: yet the ten urban household grades supply emergency levies on which prefectures depend. It will be hard to make them pay assistance fees as well.

sentences.zh: 乞詔有司，若坊場錢可足衙前雇直，則詳究條目，徐行而觀之。」

translations.literal: I beg an edict to the offices: if franchise money can suffice for yamen-runner hiring wages, then examine the regulations in detail and implement slowly while observing."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that if franchise revenues can fully fund yamen-runner wages, the regulations be reviewed in detail and implemented gradually."

sentences.zh: 帝因安石進呈役錢文字，謂之曰：「民供稅斂已重，坊郭及官戶等不須減，稅戶升等事更與少裁之。」

translations.literal: When the emperor, because Anshi presented corvée-money documents, said to him: "The people's tax burdens are already heavy; urban wards and official households need not be reduced; matters of promoting tax-paying households' grades should be cut back somewhat more."
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Anshi presented the corvée-fee regulations, the emperor told him: "The people's tax burdens are already heavy. Do not reduce fees for urban wards and official households, but cut back somewhat on rank promotions for tax-paying households."

sentences.zh: 安石曰：「朝廷製法，當斷以義，豈須規規恤淺近之人議論耶？」

translations.literal: Anshi said: "When the court makes law, it should decide by principle — must it fuss over the shallow talk of petty people?"
translations.idiomatic: Anshi replied: "When the court makes law, it must decide by principle. Why fuss over the shallow complaints of petty men?"

sentences.zh: 於是提點趙子幾怒知東明縣賈蕃不能禁遏縣民來訟，雜摭他事致蕃於理。

translations.literal: Thereupon Judicial Intendant Zhao Ziji, angry that Dongming County Magistrate Jia Fan could not restrain county people from suing, mixed in other matters to bring Fan to trial.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial Intendant Zhao Ziji, furious that Magistrate Jia Fan of Dongming County had failed to stop the petitioners, fabricated other charges and brought him to trial.

sentences.zh: 又使子幾自鞫之。

translations.literal: He also had Ziji personally interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: He even ordered Ziji to interrogate Fan personally.

sentences.zh: 楊繪謂是希安石意指，而致縣令於罪也。

translations.literal: Yang Hui said this hoped to match Wang Anshi's intent and thereby bring the magistrate to guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hui said this was done to please Wang Anshi by punishing the magistrate.

sentences.zh: 即疏辨之曰：「子幾若劾蕃五月十日前事，臣固無言；

translations.literal: He immediately memorialized in defense saying: "If Ziji impeaches Fan for matters before the tenth day of the fifth month, your servant has nothing to say;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized in defense: "If Ziji impeaches Fan for matters before the tenth day of the fifth month, I have no objection;

sentences.zh: 若所劾後乎此日，是以威脅令佐使民不得赴訴，得為便乎？」

translations.literal: if what is impeached is after this day, is it convenient to use intimidation so clerks and assistants make the people unable to appeal?"
translations.idiomatic: but if the charges concern events after that date, is it acceptable to intimidate officials so the people cannot petition?"

sentences.zh: 又言：「助役之利一，而難行有五。

translations.literal: He also said: "Assistance corvée has one benefit but five difficulties in implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Assistance corvée has one benefit and five difficulties.

sentences.zh: 請先言其利：假如民田有一家而百頃者，亦有戶才三頃者，其等乃俱在第一，以百頃而較三頃，則已三十倍矣，而受役月日，均齊無異；

translations.literal: Allow me first to speak of the benefit: suppose among the people's fields one family has a hundred qing and another household only three qing — their grades are both in the first rank; comparing a hundred qing to three qing, it is already thirty times, yet the months and days of corvée service are equal without difference;
translations.idiomatic: The benefit first: suppose one household holds a hundred qing and another only three, yet both rank in the first grade. Under the old rotation system they served the same months of corvée — a thirtyfold disparity;

sentences.zh: 況如官戶，則除耆長外皆應無役，今例使均出雇錢，則百頃所輸必三十倍於三頃者，而又永無決射之訟，此其利也。

translations.literal: moreover official households, except elders, should all have no corvée; now they are uniformly made to pay hiring money — then a hundred-qing household pays necessarily thirty times a three-qing household, and forever has no disputes over rotation — this is the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: official households, except elders, were formerly exempt. Now the hundred-qing household pays thirty times what the three-qing household pays, and rotation disputes end forever. That is the benefit.

sentences.zh: 然難行之說亦有五：民惟種田，而責其輸錢，錢非田之所出，一也。

translations.literal: Yet the arguments for difficulty in implementation also have five: the people only plant fields yet are charged to pay money — money is not produced by fields — first.
translations.idiomatic: The five difficulties: farmers are required to pay cash, but cash does not grow in fields — first.

sentences.zh: 近邊州軍，就募者非土著，奸細難防，二也。

translations.literal: Near border army districts, those recruited locally are not natives; spies are hard to guard against — second.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier, recruits are not natives and spies are hard to detect — second.

sentences.zh: 逐處田稅，多少不同，三也。

translations.literal: In each place land tax differs in amount — third.
translations.idiomatic: Land-tax rates vary from place to place — third.

sentences.zh: 耆長雇人，則盜賊難止，四也。

translations.literal: If elders hire people, bandits are hard to stop — fourth.
translations.idiomatic: If elders hire substitutes, banditry will be hard to suppress — fourth.

sentences.zh: 衙前雇人，則失陷官物，五也。

translations.literal: If yamen runners hire people, official goods are lost — fifth.
translations.idiomatic: If yamen runners hire substitutes, official goods will be lost — fifth.

sentences.zh: 乞先議防此五害，然後著為定制，仍先戒農寺無欲速就以祈恩賞，提舉司無得多取於民以自為功，如此則誰復妄議。」

translations.literal: I beg first to deliberate guarding against these five harms, then enact as fixed regulations; still first warn the Ministry of Agriculture not to seek haste to win favor and rewards, and intendants not to take much from the people to make their own merit — thus who would again speak rashly?"
translations.idiomatic: Guard against these five harms first, then enact permanent regulations. Warn the Ministry of Agriculture not to rush for rewards and intendants not to over-collect for personal credit — then who will complain without cause?"

sentences.zh: 劉摯亦言：「趙子幾以他事捃摭賈蕃為過，且變更役法，意欲便民，民苟以為有利害也，安可禁其所欲言！

translations.literal: Liu Zhi also said: "Zhao Ziji gathered other matters to make Jia Fan's offense, and moreover changed corvée law intending to benefit the people — if the people think there is benefit and harm, how can their desired speech be forbidden!
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhi also said: "Zhao Ziji fabricated charges against Jia Fan while reforming corvée law to benefit the people. If the people see benefit and harm in the law, how can their speech be forbidden?

sentences.zh: 今因畿民有訴，而刻薄之人，反怒縣官不能禁遏。

translations.literal: Now because capital-region people appealed, harsh persons instead grew angry that the magistrate could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Now, because capital residents petitioned, harsh officials are angry that the magistrate failed to silence them.

sentences.zh: 臣恐四遠人情，必疑朝廷欲鉗天下之口，而職在主民者，必皆視蕃為戒，則天下休戚，陛下何由知之？

translations.literal: Your servant fears people far and near will suspect the court wishes to clamp the mouths of the realm; those whose duty is to govern the people will all take Fan as a warning — then the realm's joys and sorrows, how can Your Majesty know them?
translations.idiomatic: I fear people everywhere will suspect the court means to silence the realm. Officials charged with governing the people will take Fan as a warning. How then will Your Majesty learn the people's joys and sorrows?

sentences.zh: 子幾挾情之罪，伏請付吏部施行。」

translations.literal: Ziji's crime of personal bias — I humbly beg it be referred to the Ministry of Personnel for execution."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Ziji's abuse of authority be referred to the Ministry of Personnel for punishment."

sentences.zh: 於是同判司農寺曾布摭繪、摯所言而條奏辨詰之，其略曰：

translations.literal: Thereupon Associate Judge of the Ministry of Agriculture Zeng Bu gathered what Hui and Zhi had said and memorialized item by item to rebut them; the summary said:
translations.idiomatic: Associate director Zeng Bu of the Ministry of Agriculture then gathered the arguments of Yang Hui and Liu Zhi and rebutted them item by item. In summary:

sentences.zh: 畿內上等戶盡罷昔日衙前之役，故今所輸錢比舊受役時，其費十減四五；

translations.literal: Within the capital region, upper households all abolished former yamen-runner corvée; therefore money paid now compared to when they formerly bore corvée — their costs are reduced by four or five tenths;
translations.idiomatic: In the capital region, upper households no longer serve as yamen runners. Their cash payments are forty to fifty percent below what corvée once cost them;

sentences.zh: 中等人戶舊充弓手、手力、承符、戶長之類，今使上等及坊郭、寺觀、單丁、官戶皆出錢以助之，故其費十減六七；

translations.literal: middle households formerly filled archer, hand laborer, commission bearer, household head, and the like; now upper households and urban wards, temples, single adult males, and official households all pay money to assist them — therefore their costs are reduced by six or seven tenths;
translations.idiomatic: middle households once served as archers, hand laborers, commission bearers, and household heads. Now upper households, urban wards, temples, single adult males, and official households contribute toward hiring substitutes, cutting middle-household costs by sixty to seventy percent;

sentences.zh: 下等人戶盡除前日冗役，而專充壯丁，且不輸一錢，故其費十減八九。

translations.literal: lower households entirely removed former redundant corvée and exclusively serve as stalwart youth, moreover paying not one cash — therefore their costs are reduced by eight or nine tenths.
translations.idiomatic: lower households shed redundant duties, serve only as stalwart youth, and pay nothing — an eighty to ninety percent reduction.

sentences.zh: 大抵上戶所減之費少，下戶所減之費多。

translations.literal: Generally, upper households' reduced costs are few, lower households' reduced costs are many.
translations.idiomatic: In short, upper households save less in absolute terms; lower households save far more.

sentences.zh: 言者謂優上戶而虐下戶，得聚斂之謗，臣所未諭也。

translations.literal: Speakers say the law favors upper households and abuses lower households, earning the reproach of extortion — this your servant does not understand.
translations.idiomatic: Critics claim the law favors the wealthy and oppresses the poor, inviting charges of extortion. I do not understand that charge.

sentences.zh: 提舉司以諸縣等第不實，故首立品量升降之法，開封府、司農寺方奏議時，蓋不知已嘗增減舊數。

translations.literal: Intendants because household grades in all counties were untrue first established methods for assessing promotion and demotion; when Kaifeng Prefecture and the Ministry of Agriculture were just memorializing deliberation, they probably did not know old numbers had already been increased and decreased.
translations.idiomatic: Because county registers were inaccurate, intendants first established rank-assessment procedures. When Kaifeng Prefecture and the Ministry of Agriculture were deliberating, they may not have known ranks had already been adjusted.

sentences.zh: 然舊敕每三年一造簿書，等第嘗有升降，則今品量增減亦未為非；

translations.literal: Yet old edicts required registers remade every three years, grades having promotion and demotion — then today's assessment increases and decreases are also not wrong;
translations.idiomatic: Yet old regulations required new registers every three years with rank adjustments. Today's reassessments are therefore not improper;

sentences.zh: 又況方曉諭民戶，苟有未便，皆與厘正，則凡所增減，實未嘗行。

translations.literal: moreover they were just instructing households; if anything was inconvenient, all was corrected with them — then all increases and decreases in fact had not been implemented.
translations.idiomatic: moreover households were being instructed, and any inconvenience was corrected. In fact, most adjustments were never implemented.

sentences.zh: 言者則以謂品量立等者，蓋欲多斂雇錢，升補上等以足配錢之數。

translations.literal: Speakers say those establishing grades by assessment wished chiefly to collect more hiring money, promoting and supplementing upper grades to fill the quota of assigned money.
translations.idiomatic: Critics say rank assessments were designed chiefly to collect more hiring fees by promoting households to upper grades.

sentences.zh: 至於祥符等縣，以上等人戶數多減充下等，乃獨掩而不言，此臣所未諭也。

translations.literal: As for Xiangfu and other counties, where numerous upper households were reduced to lower grades — this alone they conceal and do not speak of — this your servant does not understand.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu and other counties, many upper households were demoted to lower rank — a fact critics conceal. I do not understand that omission.

sentences.zh: 凡州縣之役，無不可募人之理。

translations.literal: For all prefecture and county corvée, there is none that cannot employ hired persons in principle.
translations.idiomatic: In principle, every prefectural and county duty can be filled by hired labor.

sentences.zh: 今投名衙前半天下，未嘗不典主倉庫、場務、綱運；

translations.literal: Today registered-name yamen runners in half the realm have never failed to manage granaries, market offices, and transport convoys;
translations.idiomatic: Registered yamen runners across half the empire routinely manage granaries, market offices, and transport convoys;

sentences.zh: 而承符、手力之類，舊法皆許雇人，行之久矣；

translations.literal: and commission bearers, hand laborers, and the like — old law all permitted hiring people, practiced long already;
translations.idiomatic: commission bearers and hand laborers have long been permitted to hire substitutes under old law;

sentences.zh: 惟耆長、壯丁，以今所措置最為輕役，故但輪差鄉戶，不復募人。

translations.literal: only elders and stalwart youth, because present arrangements are the lightest corvée, therefore only rotate assignment among township households and do not again recruit people.
translations.idiomatic: only elders and stalwart youth, being the lightest duties under the new system, are still assigned by rotation among township households rather than hired out.

sentences.zh: 言者則以謂衙前雇人，則失陷官物；

translations.literal: speakers say if yamen runners hire people, official goods are lost;
translations.idiomatic: Critics say hiring substitutes for yamen runners will lose official goods;

sentences.zh: 耆長雇人，則盜賊難止；

translations.literal: if elders hire people, bandits are hard to stop;
translations.idiomatic: hiring substitutes for elders will fail to stop bandits;

sentences.zh: 又以謂近邊奸細之人應募，則焚燒倉庫，或守把城門，則恐潛通外境，此臣所未諭也。

translations.literal: they also say if spies on the near frontier are recruited, they will burn granaries; or if guarding city gates, I fear secret communication with foreign borders — this your servant does not understand.
translations.idiomatic: they also fear frontier spies will burn granaries or open city gates to the enemy. I do not understand these fears.

sentences.zh: 免役或輸見錢，或納斛斗，皆從民便，為法至此，亦已周矣。

translations.literal: Exemption-from-corvée may pay cash on the spot or deliver grain measures — all follow the people's convenience; the law reaching this point is already thorough.
translations.idiomatic: The exemption fee may be paid in cash or grain, whichever suits the people. The law is already comprehensive.

sentences.zh: 言者則謂直使輸錢，則絲帛粟麥必賤；

translations.literal: speakers say if people are made directly to pay money, silk, cloth, millet, and wheat must become cheap;
translations.idiomatic: Critics say requiring cash payment will depress prices for silk, cloth, millet, and wheat;

sentences.zh: 若用他物準直為錢，則又退揀乞索，且為民害。

translations.literal: if other goods are used to convert value into money, then again there is rejection, selection, and begging — and harm to the people.
translations.idiomatic: if goods are accepted in lieu of cash, officials will reject, select, and extort — harming the people.

sentences.zh: 如此則當如何而可？

translations.literal: If so, what then can be done?
translations.idiomatic: What then is to be done?

sentences.zh: 此臣所未諭也。

translations.literal: This your servant does not understand.
translations.idiomatic: I do not see the dilemma.

sentences.zh: 昔之徭役皆百姓所為，雖凶荒饑饉，未嘗罷役；

translations.literal: Former corvée was all performed by the common people; even in famine and hunger, corvée was never suspended;
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system the people performed corvée in person; even in famine years, corvée was never suspended;

sentences.zh: 今役錢必欲稍有餘羨，乃所以為凶年蠲減之備，其餘又專以興田利、增吏祿。

translations.literal: now corvée money must deliberately retain some surplus — this is precisely preparation for reduction in bad years; the remainder is devoted to promoting farmland benefit and increasing clerks' salaries.
translations.idiomatic: now a modest surplus is deliberately retained as a reserve for reductions in bad years; the remainder funds farmland projects and clerks' salaries.

sentences.zh: 言者則以謂助錢非如稅賦有倚閣減放之期，臣不知昔之衙前、弓手、承符、手力之類，亦嘗倚閣減放否？

translations.literal: speakers say assistance money is not like tax levies with periods of deferral and reduction — your servant does not know whether former yamen runners, archers, commission bearers, hand laborers, and the like also had deferral and reduction?
translations.idiomatic: Critics say assistance fees lack the tax system's deferrals and reductions. Did yamen runners, archers, commission bearers, and hand laborers ever receive such relief under the old system?

sentences.zh: 此臣所未諭也。

translations.literal: This your servant does not understand.
translations.idiomatic: I do not understand that objection either.

sentences.zh: 兩浙一路，戶一百四十餘萬，所輸緡錢七十萬爾；

translations.literal: The Two Zhe circuit had more than 1.4 million households, paying only seven hundred thousand strings of cash;
translations.idiomatic: The two Zhe circuits, with more than 1.4 million households, collected only 700,000 strings;

sentences.zh: 而畿內戶十六萬，率緡錢亦十六萬。

translations.literal: while within the capital region 160,000 households paid on average 160,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: while the capital region, with 160,000 households, collected about 160,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 是兩浙所輸才半畿內，然畿內用以募役，所餘亦自無幾。

translations.literal: Thus Two Zhe paid only half the capital region — yet the capital region used it all for recruiting corvée; surplus was itself scant.
translations.idiomatic: Two Zhe therefore paid only half what the capital region collected per household, and the capital region spent nearly all of it on hiring labor, leaving little surplus.

sentences.zh: 言者則以謂吏緣法意，廣收大計，如兩浙欲以羨錢徼幸，司農欲以出剩為功，此臣所未諭也。

translations.literal: speakers say clerks exploiting the law's intent broadly collected grand totals — as Two Zhe wished to use surplus money to seek favor, the Ministry of Agriculture wished to use excess as merit — this your servant does not understand.
translations.idiomatic: Critics claim officials exploited the law to collect excessively — Two Zhe seeking favor through surplus funds, the Ministry of Agriculture seeking credit through over-collection. I do not understand that charge.

sentences.zh: 賈蕃為令，不受民訴，使趨京師喧嘩，其意必有謂也。

translations.literal: Jia Fan as magistrate did not accept the people's appeals, making them rush to the capital to clamor — his intent surely had its reasons.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate, Jia Fan refused the people's petitions and drove them to clamor in the capital — he surely had his reasons.

sentences.zh: 誠令用心無他，亦可謂不職矣。

translations.literal: If truly his intent had no other motive, he could still be called derelict in duty.
translations.idiomatic: Even if his motives were pure, he was still derelict in duty.

sentences.zh: 蕃之不職不法，其狀甚眾，皆趙子幾所不得不問；

translations.literal: Fan's dereliction and lawlessness — the instances are very numerous; all were matters Zhao Ziji could not fail to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: Fan's dereliction and lawlessness were numerous; Zhao Ziji could not fail to investigate them;

sentences.zh: 御史之言，欲舍蕃而治子幾，是不顧陛下之法、陛下之民，宜莫如蕃與御史也。

translations.literal: the censor's words wished to abandon Fan and punish Ziji — this disregards Your Majesty's laws and Your Majesty's people; none should be more so than Fan and the censor.
translations.idiomatic: the censors wish to abandon Fan and punish Ziji instead — disregarding Your Majesty's laws and people. Fan and the censors are the ones at fault.

sentences.zh: 於是下其疏於繪、摯，使各言狀。

translations.literal: Thereupon his memorial was sent down to Hui and Zhi, ordering each to state the facts.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was then sent to Yang Hui and Liu Zhi, ordering each to state his case.

sentences.zh: 繪錄前後四奏以自辨。

translations.literal: Hui recorded his four memorials before and after to defend himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hui recorded his four prior memorials in self-defense.

sentences.zh: 摯言：「助役斂錢之法，有大臣及御史主之於內，有大臣親黨為監司、提舉官而行之於諸路，其勢順易矣；

translations.literal: Zhi said: "The method of collecting assistance corvée money has grand ministers and censors directing it within, and grand ministers' kin serving as circuit supervisors and intendants implementing it in all circuits — the momentum is smooth and easy;
translations.idiomatic: Zhi said: "The assistance-fee system has powerful ministers and censors directing it at court and their kin serving as circuit supervisors and intendants in the provinces. The momentum favors its advocates;

sentences.zh: 然曠日彌年，終未有定論，為不順乎民心而已。

translations.literal: yet days stretch to years and in the end there is no settled conclusion — only because it does not accord with the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: yet years have passed without resolution — solely because it does not accord with popular sentiment.

sentences.zh: 陛下以司農為是耶，則事盡前奏，可以覆視；
