translations.literal: If Your Majesty holds the Ministry of Agriculture correct, then matters are all in prior memorials and can be reviewed again;
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty sides with the Ministry of Agriculture, review the prior memorials;

sentences.zh: 以臣言為非耶，則貶黜而已。

translations.literal: if your servant's words are wrong, then demotion and dismissal only.
translations.idiomatic: if my words are wrong, demote me and be done with it.

sentences.zh: 雖復使臣言之，亦不過所謂十害者，而風憲之官，豈當與有司較是非勝負耶？」

translations.literal: Even if your servant speaks again, it would not go beyond the so-called ten harms; yet should censorial-impeachment officials contend with regular administrators over right, wrong, victory, and defeat?
translations.idiomatic: Even if I speak again, I would only repeat the so-called ten harms. Should censorial officials really wrangle over right and wrong with the executive agencies?

sentences.zh: 詔繪知鄭州；

translations.literal: 」An edict appointed Hui prefect of Zhengzhou;
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Yang Hui prefect of Zhengzhou;

sentences.zh: 摯落館閣校勘、監察御史裏行，監衡州鹽倉。

translations.literal: Zhi was removed from Hanlin collation reviewer and investigative censor junior commissioner, and made supervisor of the Hengzhou salt depot.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhi was stripped of his posts as Hanlin collation reviewer and junior investigative censor and assigned to supervise the Hengzhou salt depot.

sentences.zh: 遣察訪使遍行諸路，促成役書，改助役為免役，不願就募而強之者論如律。

translations.literal: Investigative envoys were dispatched to travel all circuits, hasten corvée manuals, change assistance corvée fee to exemption-from-corvée fee; those unwilling to take hired corvée yet forced — prosecuted per statute.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent investigative envoys through every circuit to complete corvée registers, renamed the assistance corvée fee as the exemption-from-corvée fee, and prescribed statutory penalties for anyone pressed into hired corvée against his will.

sentences.zh: 初，詔監司各定所部助役錢數，利路轉運使李瑜欲定四十萬，判官鮮于侁曰：「利路民貧，二十萬足矣。」

translations.literal: Initially an edict ordered supervisory commissioners each to fix their jurisdiction's assistance corvée money amount; Lizhou transit commissioner Li Yu wished to fix four hundred thousand; junior commissioner Xianyu Shen said: "Lizhou's people are poor — two hundred thousand suffices."
translations.idiomatic: An edict had ordered each supervisory commissioner to set his circuit's assistance corvée levy. Lizhou transit commissioner Li Yu proposed four hundred thousand strings; his aide Xianyu Shen objected: "Lizhou is poor — two hundred thousand is enough."

sentences.zh: 議不合，遂各為奏。

translations.literal: They could not agree and each memorialized separately.
translations.idiomatic: They deadlocked and each submitted a separate memorial.

sentences.zh: 帝是侁議。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved Shen's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sided with Xianyu Shen.

sentences.zh: 侍御史鄧綰言利路役歲須緡錢九萬餘，而李瑜率取至三十三萬有奇，提點刑獄周約亦占名無異辭。

translations.literal: Remonstrance censor Deng Zuan said Lizhou corvée yearly needed over ninety thousand strings of cash, yet Li Yu in rough taking reached over three hundred thirty thousand odd; judicial intendant Zhou Yue also lent his name with no differing words.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance censor Deng Zuan reported that Lizhou's corvée actually required just over ninety thousand strings per year, yet Li Yu had levied more than three hundred thirty thousand; judicial intendant Zhou Yue had cosigned without dissent.

sentences.zh: 詔責瑜、約，而擢侁為副使。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Yu and Yue, while promoting Shen to deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict censured Li Yu and Zhou Yue and promoted Xianyu Shen to deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 諸路役書既上之司農，乃頒募役法於天下，用免役錢祿內外胥吏，有祿而贓者，用倉法重其坐。

translations.literal: Once all circuits' corvée manuals had been submitted to the Ministry of Agriculture, the hired corvée law was then promulgated empire-wide; exemption-from-corvée money was used to salary inner and outer clerks; those with salary yet embezzling — granary law aggravated their punishment.
translations.idiomatic: After every circuit submitted its corvée register to the Ministry of Agriculture, the hired corvée law was promulgated nationwide. Exemption-from-corvée funds paid salaries for clerks throughout the bureaucracy; embezzling salaried clerks faced aggravated penalties under the granary statutes.

sentences.zh: 初，京師賦吏祿，歲僅四千緡。

translations.literal: Initially the capital's tax-clerk salaries yearly were only four thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: At first the capital allocated only four thousand strings of cash per year for tax clerks' salaries.

sentences.zh: 至八年，計緡錢三十八萬有奇，京師吏舊有祿及外路吏祿又不在是焉。

translations.literal: By the eighth year, reckoned strings of cash three hundred eighty thousand odd; capital clerks' old salaries and outer-circuit clerks' salaries were again not within this.
translations.idiomatic: By year eight the total had risen to more than three hundred eighty thousand strings, not counting existing capital salaries or clerks' pay in the outer circuits.

sentences.zh: 時知長葛縣樂京稱助役之法不可久行，常平司詢其故，不答，遂罷。

translations.literal: At the time Le Jing, magistrate of Changge, said the assistance corvée method could not long be practiced; the Ever-Normal Office inquired the reason — he did not answer and was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Le Jing, magistrate of Changge, declared that the assistance corvée system could not endure. The Ever-Normal Office asked why; he refused to answer and was removed.

sentences.zh: 京西使者召知湖陽縣劉蒙會議，蒙不肯議，退而條上利害，即投劾去。

translations.literal: The Western Capital envoy summoned Liu Meng, magistrate of Huyang, to confer; Meng refused to confer, retired and memorialized itemizing benefits and harms, then immediately submitted impeachment of himself and left.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital envoy summoned Liu Meng, magistrate of Huyang, to consult; Meng declined, submitted a detailed critique, resigned, and left office.

sentences.zh: 而權江西提刑提舉金君卿首募受代官部錢帛綱趨京，不差鄉戶衙前，而費減十五六。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Acting Jiangxi judicial intendant and intendant Jin Junqing first recruited corvée for receiving-the-successor-official escort money-and-silk bale convoys rushing the capital, not assigning village-household yamen runners, and costs were reduced by fifteen or sixteen parts in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Jiangxi judicial intendant and intendant Jin Junqing pioneered hiring corvée labor for escorting successor-official money and silk convoys to the capital instead of drafting village yamen runners, cutting costs by roughly one-sixth.

sentences.zh: 賜詔獎諭，仍落權為真。

translations.literal: Bestowed edict of praise and instruction, and also removed "acting" to make full appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rewarded him with an edict of praise and confirmed his acting appointment as permanent.

sentences.zh: 免役剩錢，詔州縣用常平法給散休息，添給吏人餐錢，仍立為法。

translations.literal: Exemption-from-corvée surplus money — edict ordered prefectures and counties to use Ever-Normal method to distribute for rest breaks, add supply clerks' and functionaries' meal money, and still establish as law.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus exemption-from-corvée funds were to be distributed under Ever-Normal Office rules for seasonal rest and supplemental meals for clerks, and this was codified.

sentences.zh: 京東免役錢以秋料起催，若雇直多少、役使重輕有未究者，命監司詳具來上，仍須熙寧七年乃行。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital exemption-from-corvée money was to start collection from autumn land-tax quota; if hired-pay how much and corvée-service heavy-light had unexamined points, ordered supervisory commissioners to detail and submit, still requiring Xining year seven only then to implement.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei East was to collect exemption-from-corvée fees with the autumn tax; where hire rates or corvée burdens remained unsettled, supervisory commissioners were to report in full, effective no earlier than the seventh year of Xining.

sentences.zh: 永興、秦鳳比之他路，民貧役重，詔提舉司並省冗役，次第蠲減，當留二分寬剩，以為水旱閣放之備。

translations.literal: Yongxing and Qinfeng compared to other circuits — people poor, corvée heavy; edict ordered intendant offices jointly to cut redundant corvée, stepwise remit and reduce, should retain two-tenths surplus reserve, to serve as flood-drought closed granary release reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxing and Qinfeng faced heavier corvée burdens than other circuits; the court ordered their intendant offices to trim redundant duties and reduce levies in stages, retaining a two-tenths surplus reserve against flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔：「役錢千別納頭子五錢，凡修官舍，作什器，夫力輦運之類，皆許取以供費；

translations.literal: Seventh year, edict: "Corvée money per thousand separately pay header-fee five cash; all repairing official quarters, making utensils, laborers' hauling transport and the like — all permitted to take for supplying expenses;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year an edict declared: For every thousand cash of corvée levies, five cash in processing fees might be retained to cover repairs of government buildings, furnishings, porterage, and similar costs;

sentences.zh: 不給，以情輕贖銅錢足之。

translations.literal: If not supplied, according to circumstance lightly redeem with copper cash to make up.
translations.idiomatic: Shortfalls were to be made up through discretionary commutation to copper-cash fines.

sentences.zh: 諸路公人如弓箭手法，給田募人為之。

translations.literal: All circuits' public functionaries such as bowmen and archery instructors — grant fields to recruit people to perform them.
translations.idiomatic: Public posts such as archery instructors in every circuit were to be filled by hiring corvée recruits granted land allotments.

sentences.zh: 凡逃、絕、監牧之田籍於轉運司者，不許射買請佃。

translations.literal: All abandoned, forfeited, and pasturage lands registered to the transit commission — not permitted shooting-bid or lease petitions.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoned, escheated, and government pasture lands held by the transit commission could not be auctioned or leased privately.

sentences.zh: 提刑司以其田給應募者，而核其所直，準一年雇役為錢幾何，而歸其直於轉運司。」

translations.literal: The judicial intendant office used such fields to grant those answering recruitment, yet verified their value, matched one year's hired corvée as money how much, and returned the value to the transit commission."
translations.idiomatic: The judicial intendant was to assign such land to recruits, appraise its value at one year's hire-corvée equivalent, and remit that sum to the transit commission."

sentences.zh: 衢州西安縣用緡錢十二萬買田，始足募一縣之役。

translations.literal: Quzhou's Xi'an county used strings of cash one hundred twenty thousand to buy fields, only then sufficed to recruit one county's corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an county in Quzhou had to spend one hundred twenty thousand strings of cash on land before it could fully staff the county's hired corvée.

sentences.zh: 司農寺言，不獨兩浙如此，他路宜亦如之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Agriculture said — not only Two Zhe thus; other circuits should likewise be so.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Agriculture noted that Two Zhe was not unique and other circuits should follow suit.

sentences.zh: 費多難贍，乃欲改法。

translations.literal: Expense great, hard to sustain — thus wished to change the method.
translations.idiomatic: The expense proved unsustainable and officials sought to revise the law.

sentences.zh: 遂詔自今用寬剩錢買募役田，須先參會餘錢可以枝梧災傷，方許給買。

translations.literal: Thereupon edict: from now using surplus reserve money to buy recruitment corvée fields — must first consult remaining money can prop disaster harm, only then permit grant purchase.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ruled that surplus reserve funds could buy recruitment-corvée land only after confirming adequate reserves to cover disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 若田價翔貴之地，則已之。

translations.literal: If land prices soaring dear in the place, then stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Where land prices were too high, the program was to be suspended.

sentences.zh: 時免役出錢或未均，參知政事呂惠卿及其弟曲陽縣尉和卿皆請行手實法。

translations.literal: At the time exemption-from-corvée money paid out perhaps not even; Councillor Lu Huiqing and his younger brother Quyang county captain Heqing all requested implementing self-reporting of assets method.
translations.idiomatic: Because exemption-from-corvée payments were still uneven, Councillor Lu Huiqing and his brother Heqing, captain of Quyang county, both urged adoption of the self-reporting of assets method.

sentences.zh: 其法：官為定立田產中價，使民各以田畝多少高下，隨價自占；

translations.literal: Its method: officials for them established median price of field property, making commoners each according to field mu how much high-low, following price self-declare;
translations.idiomatic: Under the method officials set median land prices and each household self-declared holdings by acreage and grade at those prices;

sentences.zh: 仍並屋宅分有無蕃息立等，凡居錢五當蕃息之錢一。

translations.literal: Still combining residential dwellings divided have-not and reproductive-gain established grades; all dwelling money five counts as reproductive-gain money one.
translations.idiomatic: Houses were graded by value and productive assets; every five cash of dwelling was reckoned as one cash of productive wealth.

sentences.zh: 非用器田穀而輒隱落者許告，有實，以三分之一充賞。

translations.literal: Those not using utensils field grain yet rashly concealing and dropping — permitted to inform; if substantiated, use one-third as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Concealment of non-farm assets was subject to denunciation; a third of recovered levies went to the informer.

sentences.zh: 將造簿，預具式示民，令依式為狀，縣受而籍之。

translations.literal: About to compile register, beforehand prepare form to show commoners, order according to form make declaration, county receive and register it.
translations.idiomatic: Before compiling registers, officials distributed sample forms for households to file declarations, which counties accepted and recorded.

sentences.zh: 以其價列定高下，分為五等。

translations.literal: According to their prices array and fix high-low, divide into five grades.
translations.idiomatic: Properties were ranked into five grades by assessed value.

sentences.zh: 既該見一縣之民物產錢數，乃參會通縣役錢本額而定所當輸，明書其數，示眾兩月，使悉知之。

translations.literal: Once covering seeing one county's commoners' property money amount, then consult and match total county corvée money original quota to fix what ought to be paid, clearly write the numbers, show the multitude two months, make all know it.
translations.idiomatic: Once countywide assets were tallied, officials reconciled them with the corvée levy quota, published each household's assessment for two months' public notice.

sentences.zh: 詔從其請。

translations.literal: Edict followed their request.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 司農寺乞廢戶長、坊正，令州縣坊郭擇相鄰戶三二十家，排比成甲，迭為甲頭，督輸稅賦苗役，一稅一替。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Agriculture requested abolishing household heads and ward chiefs, ordering prefectures and counties in urban wards to select neighboring households twenty or thirty, arrange into mutual-aid bands, rotate as band heads, oversee delivering tax grain and tax corvée, one tax one rotation.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Agriculture proposed abolishing household and ward heads, grouping twenty to thirty neighboring urban households into rotating mutual-aid bands to collect taxes and corvée fees.

sentences.zh: 其後，諸路皆言甲頭催稅未便，遂詔耆戶長、壯丁仍舊募充，其保正、甲頭、承帖法並罷。

translations.literal: Afterwards, all circuits all said band-head tax collection not convenient, thereupon edict: elders, household heads, strong youths still as before recruited to fill posts; the band-chief, band-head, and receipt-post methods all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When circuits reported that band heads made tax collection harder, the court restored the old practice of hiring elders, household heads, and strong youths, abolishing the band chief and receipt-runner systems.

sentences.zh: 王安石言給田募役，有害十餘。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said granting-fields hired corvée had more than ten harms.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi listed more than ten harms in the grant-land recruitment corvée system.

sentences.zh: 八年，罷給田募役法，已就募人如舊，闕者弗補。

translations.literal: Eighth year, abolished grant-fields hired corvée method; already enlisted recruits as before, vacancies not replenished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the grant-land recruitment corvée law was repealed: existing recruits stayed on, vacancies were left unfilled.

sentences.zh: 官戶輸役錢免其半，所免雖多，各無過二十千。

translations.literal: Official households paying corvée money exempted half; though exempted much, each not exceed twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Official households paid half the standard corvée fee, capped at twenty thousand cash each.

sentences.zh: 兩縣以上有物產者通計之，兩州兩縣以上有物產者隨所在輸錢，等第不及者從一多處並之。

translations.literal: Two counties or more having property — tally together; two prefectures two counties or more having property — follow where located pay money; grade not reaching — follow one more-numerous place combine them.
translations.idiomatic: Property holders in multiple counties or prefectures were assessed jointly, paying through the jurisdiction with the higher grade or the larger assessment base.

sentences.zh: 初，手實法行，言者多論其長告訐，增煩擾。

translations.literal: Initially, self-reporting of assets method practiced, speakers mostly discussed its encouraging informing and denunciation, increasing vexation and disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: At first the self-reporting of assets method drew criticism for encouraging mutual denunciation and extra harassment.

sentences.zh: 至是，惠卿罷政，御史中丞鄧綰言其法不便，罷之，委司農寺再詳定以聞。

translations.literal: At this time Huiqing left office; censor-in-chief Deng Zuan said its method inconvenient, abolished it, entrusted Ministry of Agriculture again to examine in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: When Huiqing fell from power, censor-in-chief Deng Zuan condemned the method and had it abolished, directing the Ministry of Agriculture to draft a replacement.

sentences.zh: 九年，以荊湖兩路敷役錢太重，較一歲入出，寬剩錢數多，詔權減二年。

translations.literal: Ninth year, because Jing-Hu two circuits spreading corvée money too heavy, compared one year income outlay, surplus reserve money numbers many — edict temporarily reduced two years.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Jing and Hu circuits' levies were found excessive; surplus reserves were high, so collections were temporarily reduced for two years.

sentences.zh: 尋詔自今寬剩役錢及買撲坊場錢，更不以給役人，歲具羨數上之司農，餘物凡籍之常平司者，常留一半。

translations.literal: Soon edict: from now surplus reserve corvée money and purchased licensed ward-shop money — no longer use to pay corvée personnel; yearly compile surplus amounts submit to Ministry of Agriculture; remaining goods all registered to Ever-Normal Office — always retain half.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the court barred using surplus corvée reserves and licensed-shop purchase funds to pay corvée staff; annual surpluses were reported to the Ministry of Agriculture, and Ever-Normal Office holdings were to retain half in reserve.

sentences.zh: 侍御史周尹言：「募役錢數外留寬剩一分，聞州縣希提舉司風旨，廣敷民錢，省役額，損雇直，而民間輸數一切如舊，寬剩數多。

translations.literal: Remonstrance censor Zhou Yin said: "Hired corvée money beyond the quota retain surplus reserve one-tenth; heard prefectures and counties hoping to match intendant office wind-intent, broadly spread commoners' money, cut corvée quotas, harm hire-pay, yet among the people payment amounts all as before, surplus reserve numbers many.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance censor Zhou Yin said: "The law allowed a one-tenth surplus reserve atop hired corvée quotas, but I hear that counties, eager to please their intendant offices, still levied the old amounts while cutting quotas and hire wages — swelling surpluses.

sentences.zh: 募直輕而倉法重，役人多不願就募。

translations.literal: Recruitment pay light yet granary law heavy — corvée personnel mostly unwilling to take recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Hire wages were too low and granary penalties too harsh, so few would accept recruitment.

sentences.zh: 天下皆謂朝廷設法聚斂，不無疑怨。

translations.literal: All-under-Heaven all said the court established law to amass and extract — not without doubt and resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Popular sentiment held that the court's policy was revenue extraction, breeding widespread resentment.

sentences.zh: 乞募耆長、戶長及役人不可過減者悉復舊額，約募錢足用，其寬剩止留二分。」

translations.literal: Request recruiting elders, household heads, and corvée personnel what must not be excessively reduced — all restore old quotas, approximate recruitment money just sufficient, its surplus reserve only retain two-tenths."
translations.idiomatic: He urged restoring prior quotas for elders, household heads, and essential corvée posts, limiting collections to actual need and capping surplus reserves at two-tenths."

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路上司農寺歲收免役錢一千四十一萬四千五百五十三貫、石、匹、兩：金銀錢斛匹帛一千四十一萬四千三百五十二貫、石、匹、兩，絲綿二百一兩；

translations.literal: That year, all circuits submitted to the Ministry of Agriculture yearly collected exemption-from-corvée money ten million four hundred fourteen thousand five hundred fifty-three guan, shi, pi, liang: gold silver money grain pi silk ten million four hundred fourteen thousand three hundred fifty-two guan, shi, pi, liang, silk floss two hundred one liang;
translations.idiomatic: That year circuits reported to the Ministry of Agriculture annual exemption-from-corvée receipts of 10,414,553 units (guan, shi, pi, liang): 10,414,352 in gold, silver, cash, grain, bolts, and ounces of silk, plus 201 liang of floss;

sentences.zh: 支金銀錢斛六百四十八萬七千六百八十八兩、貫、石、匹；

translations.literal: disbursed gold silver money grain six million four hundred eighty-seven thousand six hundred eighty-eight liang, guan, shi, pi;
translations.idiomatic: disbursements of 6,487,688 units in gold, silver, cash, and grain;

sentences.zh: 應在銀錢斛匹帛二百六十九萬三千二十貫、匹、石、兩，見在八十七萬九千二百六十七貫、石、匹、兩。

translations.literal: due in silver money grain pi silk two million six hundred ninety-three thousand twenty guan, pi, shi, liang, on hand eight hundred seventy-nine thousand two hundred sixty-seven guan, shi, pi, liang.
translations.idiomatic: 2,693,020 still owed; 879,267 remained on hand.

sentences.zh: 十年，知彭州呂陶奏：「朝廷欲寬力役，立法召募，初無過斂民財之意，有司奉行過當，增添科出，謂之寬剩。

translations.literal: Tenth year, Pengzhou prefect Lü Tao memorialized: "The court wished to ease labor corvée, established law to summon recruitment, initially had no intent to over-extract commoners' wealth; the offices in carrying it out exceeded measure, added levies and disbursements, calling it surplus reserve.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Pengzhou prefect Lü Tao wrote: "The court meant to lighten corvée by hiring labor, not to overtax the people; yet officials over-implemented the law, levying extra assessments they called surplus reserve.

sentences.zh: 自熙寧六年施行役法，至今四年，臣本州四縣，已有寬剩錢四萬八千七百餘貫，今歲又須科納一萬餘貫。

translations.literal: From Xining sixth year implementing corvée law, until now four years, my prefecture's four counties already have surplus reserve money forty-eight thousand seven hundred odd guan, this year again must levy over ten thousand odd guan.
translations.idiomatic: Four years after the corvée law took effect in the sixth year of Xining, my four counties already hold more than 48,700 guan in surplus reserves and must levy another 10,000-plus this year.

sentences.zh: 以成都一路計之，無慮五六十萬，推之天下，見今約有六七百萬貫寬剩在官。

translations.literal: Taking the Chengdu circuit to reckon, no less than five or six hundred thousand; extending to all-under-Heaven, presently about six or seven million guan surplus reserve in government hands.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengdu circuit alone likely holds five or six hundred thousand; empire-wide, some six or seven million guan in surplus reserves now sit in government coffers.

sentences.zh: 歲歲如此，泉幣絕乏，貨法不通，商旅農夫，最受其弊。

translations.literal: Year after year thus, currency utterly scarce, commodity circulation not passing, traveling merchants and farmers most receive its harm.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year this drains cash from circulation, choking trade and hitting merchants and farmers hardest.

sentences.zh: 臣恐朝廷不知免役錢外有此寬剩數目，乞契勘見今約支幾歲不至闕乏，霈發德音，特免數年；

translations.literal: Your servant fears the court does not know beyond exemption-from-corvée money there is this surplus reserve amount, requests verify presently about how many years' disbursement until not deficient, issue gracious edict, specially exempt several years;
translations.idiomatic: I fear the court does not realize how large these surpluses are beyond the exemption-from-corvée levies. Please audit how many years' expenses the reserves cover and issue a gracious exemption for several years;

sentences.zh: 或逐年限定，不得過十分之一。

translations.literal: Or by each year fix a limit, not permitted to exceed one-tenth.
translations.idiomatic: or cap annual surplus collections at one-tenth.

sentences.zh: 所貴民不重困。」

translations.literal: What is prized is that the people not again heavily distressed."
translations.idiomatic: The aim was that the people would not be crushed anew."

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No response.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not reply.

sentences.zh: 王安石去位，吳充為相，沈括獻議莫若稍變役法，雜以差徭為便。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi left office, Wu Chong became chancellor, Shen Kuo presented proposal that nothing better than slightly changing corvée law, mixing with assigned corvée and labor for convenience.
translations.idiomatic: After Wang Anshi left office, Chancellor Wu Chong received Shen Kuo's advice to soften the corvée law by blending hired service with assigned corvée.

sentences.zh: 御史知雜蔡確言括反覆，貶括知宣州。

translations.literal: Investigative censor chief Cai Que said Kuo was flip-flopping, demoted Kuo to prefect of Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chief investigative censor Cai Que accused Shen Kuo of inconsistency and had him demoted to prefect of Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 役錢立額，浙東多以田稅錢數為則，浙西多用物力。

translations.literal: Corvée money fixed quota — Eastern Zhe mostly took land-tax money amount as standard, Western Zhe mostly used physical property.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée quotas in Eastern Zhe were mostly keyed to land-tax payments, in Western Zhe to assessed property.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔令通物力、稅錢互紐為數，從便輸納。

translations.literal: At this time, edict ordered linking physical property and tax money mutually as number, follow convenience in payment.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered circuits to combine property and tax assessments and let taxpayers pay whichever was more convenient.

sentences.zh: 淮東路估定物產，如其實直，以均敷取。

translations.literal: Huai-East circuit estimated property, like its true value, to average and spread collection.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-East assessed property at true value for even distribution of levies.

sentences.zh: 初，許兩浙坊郭戶家產不及二百千，鄉村戶不及五十千，毋輸役錢，已而鄉戶不及五十千亦不免輸。

translations.literal: Initially, permitted Two Zhe urban households property not reaching two hundred thousand, rural households not reaching fifty thousand — not pay corvée money; later rural households not reaching fifty thousand also not exempt from payment.
translations.idiomatic: Two Zhe had initially exempted urban households under 200,000 cash and rural households under 50,000 from corvée fees, but rural households under 50,000 were later made to pay anyway.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年，提舉司言坊郭戶免輸法太優，乃詔如鄉戶法裁定所敷錢數。

translations.literal: Yuanyou second year, intendant office said urban households' exemption too favorable, thereupon edict like rural household method fix and decide spread money amount.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanyou the intendant office ruled urban exemptions too generous; urban households were assessed like rural ones.

sentences.zh: 提舉廣西常平劉誼言：「廣西一路戶口二十萬，而民出役錢至十九萬緡，先用稅錢敷出；

translations.literal: Guangxi Ever-Normal intendant Liu Yi said: "Guangxi one circuit household registers two hundred thousand, yet the people pay corvée money up to one hundred ninety thousand strings of cash, first using tax money to spread out;
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Ever-Normal intendant Liu Yi wrote: "Guangxi has two hundred thousand registered households yet collects up to 190,000 strings in corvée fees, first charging the land tax;

sentences.zh: 稅數不足，又敷之田米；

translations.literal: Tax amount insufficient, again spread field rice;
translations.idiomatic: when tax cash falls short, levying field rice;

sentences.zh: 田米不足，復算於身丁。

translations.literal: Field rice insufficient, again calculated on personal adult males.
translations.idiomatic: when field rice falls short, levying the head tax on adult males.

sentences.zh: 夫廣西之民，身之有丁，既稅以錢，又算以米，是一身而輸二稅，殆前世弊法。

translations.literal: Now Guangxi's people, body having adult males, already taxed with money, again calculated with rice — one body yet paying two taxes, nearly the maladies of prior-age bad laws.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi subjects already pay cash tax on every adult male, then rice tax on the same person — two taxes on one body, almost the abuses of earlier dynasties.

sentences.zh: 今既未能蠲除，而又益以役錢，甚可憫也。

translations.literal: Now though still unable to remit and remove, again added with corvée money — very pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to abolish those burdens, the government has added corvée fees on top — a grievous plight.

sentences.zh: 至於廣東西監司、提舉司吏一月之給，上同令錄，下倍攝官，乞裁損其數，則兩路身丁田米亦可少寬。」

translations.literal: As for Guangdong and Guangxi supervisory and intendant office clerks one month's pay, above equal to magistrates and registrars, below double acting officials — request cut and reduce their numbers, then both circuits' personal adult male field rice also can slightly ease."
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong and Guangxi clerks earn as much as magistrates above and twice acting officials below. Trim their salaries and both circuits could ease the head tax and field rice levies."

sentences.zh: 遂詔吏輩月給錢遞減二千，歲遂減役錢一千二百餘緡。

translations.literal: Thereupon edict clerks' monthly pay money stepwise reduced two thousand, yearly then reduced corvée money one thousand two hundred odd strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: The court cut clerks' monthly pay by two thousand cash each, saving more than 1,200 strings of corvée funds per year.

sentences.zh: 三年，司農寺丞吳雍言：「議定淮、浙役書，減冗占千三百餘人，裁省緡錢近二十九萬，會定歲用，寬剩錢一百四萬餘緡，諸路役書多若此類。

translations.literal: Third year, Ministry of Agriculture aide Wu Yong said: "Deliberated fixing Huai and Zhe corvée manuals, reduced redundant posts one thousand three hundred odd persons, cut and saved strings of cash nearly two hundred ninety thousand, met and fixed yearly use, surplus reserve money one million four hundred thousand odd strings of cash, all circuits' corvée manuals mostly like this category.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Ministry of Agriculture aide Wu Yong reported: "Revising Huai and Zhe corvée registers cut 1,300 redundant posts and nearly 290,000 strings, leaving annual surplus reserves over 1.4 million — a pattern repeated across circuits.

sentences.zh: 乞先自近京三兩路修定，下之諸路。」

translations.literal: Request first from near-capital two or three circuits revise and fix, send down to all circuits."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to start with circuits near the capital and extend revisions empire-wide."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 七年，天下免役緡錢歲計一千八百七十二萬九千三百，場務錢五百五萬九千，穀帛石匹九十七萬六千六百五十七，役錢較熙寧所入多三之一。

translations.literal: Seventh year, all-under-Heaven exemption-from-corvée strings of cash yearly reckoned eighteen million seven hundred twenty-nine thousand three hundred, ward-shop money five million five hundred ninety thousand, grain silk shi pi ninety-seven million six hundred sixty-five thousand seven hundred fifty-seven, corvée money compared to Xining income more by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh year nationwide exemption-from-corvée cash totaled 18,729,300 strings, ward-shop fees 5,590,000, and 97,665,757 units of grain and cloth; corvée revenue was one-third higher than under Xining.

sentences.zh: 帝之力主免役也，知民間通苦差役，而衙役之任重行遠者尤甚，特創免役。

translations.literal: The Emperor strongly upheld exemption-from-corvée, knowing among the people universally bitter assigned corvée, while yamen corvée duties heavy in burden long-distance travel especially severe, specially created exemption-from-corvée.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor staunchly backed exemption-from-corvée because assigned corvée had burdened the people, especially long-distance yamen-runner duties; he created the new system for that reason.

sentences.zh: 雖均敷雇直，不能不取之民；

translations.literal: Though evenly spread hire-pay, cannot not take from the people;
translations.idiomatic: Even with standardized hire wages, the levy still had to come from taxpayers;

sentences.zh: 然民得一意田畝，實解前日困弊。

translations.literal: Yet the people obtained single-minded focus on fields, truly resolving prior-day distress and exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: yet farmers could devote themselves to farming, genuinely easing the old hardships.

sentences.zh: 故群議雜起，意不為變。

translations.literal: Therefore group discussions mixed rising, intent not to change.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the uproar of debate did not shake his resolve.

sentences.zh: 顧其間采王安石策，不正用雇直為額，而展敷二分以備吏祿、水旱之用。

translations.literal: Yet in the meantime adopting Wang Anshi's policy, not correctly using hire-pay as quota, but extending spread two-tenths to supply clerks' salaries and flood-drought use.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Wang Anshi's plan, however, not fixing quotas to actual hire costs but padding collections by two-tenths for clerk salaries and disaster reserves.

sentences.zh: 群臣每以為言，屢疑屢詰，而安石持之益堅。

translations.literal: The ministers each time spoke on it, repeatedly doubted repeatedly questioned, yet Anshi held it increasingly firm.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers protested again and again, but Wang Anshi held all the firmer.

sentences.zh: 此其為法既不究終防弊，而聚斂小人又乘此增取，帝雖數詔禁戒，而不能盡止。

translations.literal: This its being law already did not examine to the end and guard against abuses, while amass-and-extract petty men again rode this to increase taking; the Emperor though several edicts forbade and warned, yet could not fully stop.
translations.idiomatic: The statute itself lacked safeguards, and grasping officials exploited it; though the Emperor repeatedly forbade over-collection, he could not stop it entirely.

sentences.zh: 至是，雇役不加多，而歲入比前增廣，則安石不能將順德意，其流弊已見矣。

translations.literal: At this time, hired corvée did not add more, yet yearly income compared to before increased and broadened — then Anshi could not accord with virtuous intent, its flowing abuses already visible.
translations.idiomatic: By then hired corvée rolls had not grown, yet revenue had swollen — a sign that Wang Anshi's policy no longer matched the Emperor's benevolent intent and abuses were plain.

sentences.zh: 哲宗立，宣仁後垂簾同聽政，門下侍郎司馬光言：

translations.literal: The Zhezong Emperor ascended, Empress Dowager Xuanren held the curtain and jointly heard government, Gate Department vice director Sima Guang said:
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong succeeded, Empress Dowager Xuanren regented jointly with him. Vice director of the Gate Department Sima Guang said:

sentences.zh: 「按因差役破產者，惟鄉戶衙前。

translations.literal: "According to investigation, those ruined by assigned corvée are only village-household yamen runners.
translations.idiomatic: "Investigation shows that assigned corvée ruined only village yamen runners.

sentences.zh: 蓋山野愚戇之人，不能幹事，或因水火損敗官物，或為上下侵欺乞取，是致欠折，備償不足，有破產者。

translations.literal: For mountain wild foolish dull persons cannot manage affairs, or because fire water damaged official goods, or because above and below encroached and begged and took — thus causing shortfall, prepared compensation insufficient, some ruined households.
translations.idiomatic: Rustic and inexperienced men could not manage the work; fire or flood might destroy official goods, or superiors and subordinates might extort them — shortfalls and indemnities then bankrupted households.

sentences.zh: 至於長名衙前，在公精熟，每經重難，別得優輕場務酬獎，往往致富，何破產之有？

translations.literal: As for long-name yamen runners, in public affairs skilled, each time encountering heavy difficulty, separately obtained favorable light ward-shop rewards, often becoming wealthy — what household ruin is there?
translations.idiomatic: Long-registered yamen runners, skilled in office work, earned lighter ward-shop assignments as bonuses after hard duties and often grew rich — when did they go bankrupt?

sentences.zh: 又向者役人皆上等戶為之，其下等、單丁、女戶及品官、僧道，本來無役，今使之一概輸錢，則是賦斂愈重。

translations.literal: Moreover formerly corvée personnel were all upper-grade households doing it; lower-grade, single adult male, female household, and ranked officials, monks and Taoists — originally had no corvée; now making them all alike pay money — then is tax extraction increasingly heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly corvée fell on wealthy households while lower grades, single males, female-headed households, officials, monks, and priests were exempt; now all pay alike — a heavier tax burden.

sentences.zh: 自行免役法以來，富室差得自寬，貧者困窮日甚，監司、守令之不仁者，於雇役人之外多取羨餘，或一縣至數萬貫，以冀恩賞。

translations.literal: From implementing exemption-from-corvée law onward, wealthy houses assigned could themselves be at ease, poor people trapped poor daily more severe; supervisory commissioners and prefects and magistrates who were unkind, beyond hired corvée personnel additionally took surplus remainder, sometimes one county up to tens of thousands of guan, to hope for grace rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Since exemption-from-corvée took effect the rich have fared better while the poor grow poorer; unscrupulous officials skim surpluses beyond hire costs, sometimes tens of thousands of guan per county, seeking imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 又青苗、免役，賦斂多責見錢。

translations.literal: Moreover green sprouts and exemption-from-corvée, tax extraction mostly demanded ready cash.
translations.idiomatic: Green Sprouts loans and exemption-from-corvée alike demand payment in cash.

sentences.zh: 錢非私家所鑄，要須貿易，豐歲追限，尚失半價，若值凶年，無穀可糶，賣田不售，遂致殺牛賣肉，伐桑鬻薪，來年生計，不暇復顧，此農民所以重困也。

translations.literal: Cash is not what private families cast; must trade for it; abundant year pursuit deadlines, still lost half price; if encountering bad year, no grain to sell, fields not sold, then led to killing oxen selling meat, cutting mulberry selling firewood, next year's livelihood, no leisure again to look back — this is why farmers are heavily distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Households do not mint money themselves and must buy it in trade. Even in good years collectors demand cash at half the grain price; in famine years, with no grain to sell and land unsold, farmers slaughter oxen, sell timber, and mortgage next year's livelihood — that is why they are crushed.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為宜悉罷免役錢，諸色役人，並如舊制定差，見雇役人皆罷遣之。

translations.literal: Your servant foolishly thinks it fitting to entirely abolish exemption-from-corvée money, all categories of corvée personnel, all like old system fix assignment, present hired corvée personnel all dismiss.
translations.idiomatic: I believe exemption-from-corvée levies should be abolished entirely, all corvée posts restored to the old assignment system, and current hires dismissed.

sentences.zh: 衙前先募人投充長名，召募不足，然後差鄉村人戶，每經歷重難差遣，依舊以優輕場務充酬獎。

translations.literal: Yamen runners first recruit people to enroll as long-name, recruitment insufficient, then assign village person households; each time experiencing heavy difficult assignment, as before use favorable light ward-shop as reward compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen runners should first be recruited as long-registered posts; only when recruitment fails should rural households be drafted, with lighter ward-shop duties as rewards after hard assignments.

sentences.zh: 所有見在役錢，撥充州縣常平本錢，以戶口為率，存三年之蓄，有餘則歸轉運司。

translations.literal: All present corvée money, allocate to fill prefectures and counties Ever-Normal principal money, by household registers as rate, store three years' accumulation, surplus then return to transit commission.
translations.idiomatic: Existing corvée funds should fund county Ever-Normal principal reserves at a per-household rate, keep three years' supply on hand, and remit the rest to the transit commission.

sentences.zh: 凡免役之法，縱富強應役之人，征貧弱不役之戶，利於富不利於貧。

translations.literal: Generally exemption-from-corvée's method, indulges the strong who should serve corvée, levies the poor weak who do not serve — benefits the rich, does not benefit the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Exemption-from-corvée lets the wealthy who once bore corvée buy out of it while taxing the poor who were never liable — it helps the rich, not the poor.

sentences.zh: 及今耳目相接，猶可復舊名，若更年深，富者安之，民不可復差役矣。」

translations.literal: While now eyes and ears still connect, still can restore old roster names; if years deepen further, the rich will settle in comfort — the people cannot again practice assigned corvée."
translations.idiomatic: While living memory still links us to the old rolls, those names can still be restored; let another generation pass and the wealthy will have grown comfortable with the new order — the people will never return to assigned corvée."

sentences.zh: 於是始詔修定役書，凡役錢，惟元定額及額外寬剩二分已下許著為準，餘並除之。

translations.literal: Thereupon first edict to revise and fix corvée manuals: for all corvée money, only the original fixed quota and surplus reserve outside the quota of two-tenths and below were permitted as the standard; the rest were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered revision of the corvée registers: only the original fixed quota plus a surplus reserve of up to two-tenths could be retained; all other surcharges were abolished.

sentences.zh: 若寬剩元不及二分者，自如舊則。

translations.literal: If the surplus reserve originally did not reach two-tenths, it naturally followed the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: Where the surplus reserve had always been below two-tenths, the old rate would stand.

sentences.zh: 尋詔耆戶長、壯丁皆仍舊募人供役，保正、甲頭、承帖人並罷。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered that elders, household heads, and stalwart youth should all again supply corvée through hired recruits as before; security captains, hamlet heads, and notice bearers were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, elders, household heads, and stalwart youth were again to be filled by hired recruits; security captains, hamlet heads, and notice bearers were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，侍御史劉摯言：「率戶賦錢，有從來不預差役而概被斂取者，有一戶而輸數百以至千緡者。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, attendant censor Liu Zhi said: "Levying every household for money tribute — some who from of old did not participate in assigned corvée were indiscriminately collected from; one household might submit several hundred up to a thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanyou, attendant censor Liu Zhi said: "The government levies every household for cash, including some never liable for assigned corvée; one household may pay several hundred to a thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 昔惟衙前一役，有至破產者爾。

translations.literal: Formerly only yamen-runner duty could drive one to bankruptcy.
translations.idiomatic: In the past only yamen-runner duty could ruin a household.

sentences.zh: 今天下坊場，官收而官賣之，歲計緡錢無慮數百萬，自可足衙前雇募支酬之直，則役之重者已無所事於農民矣。

translations.literal: Today the empire's ward stalls — the state collects and the state sells them — yearly reckons strings of cash without anxious count of several million; naturally can suffice yamen-runner hire and recruitment pay and reward's worth; then corvée's heavy duties already have nothing to require of farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Today the empire's ward stalls are collected and sold by the state, yielding several million strings of cash a year — enough to cover yamen-runner recruitment wages. The heaviest corvée no longer need touch the farming population.

sentences.zh: 外惟散從、承符、弓手、手力、耆戶長、壯丁之類，無大勞費，宜並用祖宗差法，自第一等而下通任之。」

translations.literal: Apart from these, only scattered attendants, notice bearers, archers, hand laborers, elder household heads, stalwart youth, and the like — no great labor expense — ought together to use the ancestral assigned method, from the first grade downward generally assigning them."
translations.idiomatic: Apart from these, scattered attendants, notice bearers, archers, hand laborers, elder household heads, and stalwart youth require little expense; they should all revert to the ancestral assigned corvée, filled in rotation from the first grade downward."

sentences.zh: 監察御史王岩叟請於衙前大役立本等相助法，以盡變通之利。

translations.literal: Supervisory censor Wang Yansou requested that for the great yamen-runner corvée a same-grade mutual-assistance law be established, to exhaust every benefit of flexible adjustment.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory censor Wang Yansou proposed a same-grade mutual-assistance rule for the great yamen-runner corvée, to realize every benefit of flexible adjustment.

sentences.zh: 借如一邑之中當應大役者百家，而歲取十人，則九十家出力為助，明年易十戶，復如之，則大役無偏重之弊；

translations.literal: Suppose in one township a hundred households ought to answer the great corvée, while each year ten persons are taken — then ninety households exert strength as assistance; next year another ten households are exchanged, again like this — then the great corvée has no bias toward undue weight;
translations.idiomatic: Suppose a township had a hundred households liable for the great corvée and each year ten served: the other ninety would contribute to their support; the following year another ten would rotate in — so the great corvée would never fall with undue weight on a few;

sentences.zh: 其於百色無名之差占，一切非理之資陪，悉用熙寧新法禁之，雖不助猶可為也。

translations.literal: As for the hundred petty unnamed assigned occupations and all unreasonable supplementary payments, all should use the Xining new law to forbid them — even without mutual assistance it could still be done.
translations.idiomatic: As for the hundred petty unauthorized assignments and all unreasonable supplementary payments, the Xining prohibitions should apply in full; even without mutual assistance, that alone would suffice.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史劉次莊言：「近製許雇耆戶長須三等已上戶。

translations.literal: Palace attendant censor Liu Cizhuang said: "A recent regulation permits hiring elder household heads only from third-grade households and above.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant censor Liu Cizhuang said: "A recent rule allows hiring elder household heads only from third-grade households and above.

sentences.zh: 不知三等已上戶不願受雇，既無願者，則郡縣必陽循雇名，陰用差法，不若立法明差之為便。」

translations.literal: They do not realize that third-grade households and above are unwilling to accept hire; since there are no willing persons, prefectures and counties must outwardly comply with the hire name while inwardly using assigned corvée — not as convenient as establishing a law that clearly assigns corvée."
translations.idiomatic: Third-grade households and above will not accept hire," he said. "With no volunteers, prefectures and counties will pay lip service to hiring while secretly assigning corvée; it would be simpler to legislate open assigned corvée."

sentences.zh: 戶部言：「詔凡耆戶長、壯丁並募人供役，竊慮耆戶長雇錢數少，無應募者。

translations.literal: The Household Ministry said: "The edict orders that all elder household heads and stalwart youth supply corvée through recruited persons — we privately fear that elder household head hire money is too small and there will be no one answering recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: The Household Ministry replied: "The edict requires elders, household heads, and stalwart youth to be filled by recruits, but we fear the hire wages for elder household heads are too low and no one will volunteer.

sentences.zh: 兼四等以下戶舊不敷役錢，惟輪差壯丁，今悉雇募，用錢額廣，提舉司必從人戶增敷。

translations.literal: Moreover, fourth-grade households and below of old did not pay corvée money but only rotated assignment of stalwart youth; now all are hired through recruitment — money used is broad in amount, and intendant offices will certainly increase spreading from households.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth-grade households and below never paid corvée money but only served as stalwart youth on rotation; now all are to be hired, widening the cash burden — intendant offices will surely raise levies on households.

sentences.zh: 蓋舊法役不盡雇，亦有輪差輪募之處，欲且如本法。」

translations.literal: Generally the old law did not hire corvée entirely; there were also places of rotated assignment and rotated recruitment — we wish temporarily to follow the original law."
translations.idiomatic: Under the old law corvée was not entirely hired; some duties rotated by assignment and some by recruitment. We ask that the original law stand for now."

sentences.zh: 中書舍人蘇軾言：「先帝初行役法，取寬剩錢不得過二分，以備災傷。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat drafter Su Shi said: "When the former emperor first implemented the corvée law, taking surplus reserve money was not to exceed two-tenths, to prepare against disasters and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat drafter Su Shi said: "When the late emperor first enacted the corvée law, the surplus reserve was capped at two-tenths against disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 有司奉行過當，行之幾十六七年，積而不用，至三千餘萬貫石。

translations.literal: Responsible offices carried it out excessively; it was implemented for nearly sixteen or seventeen years, accumulated yet unused, reaching more than thirty million in strings and bushels.
translations.idiomatic: Offices over-applied the rule for nearly seventeen years, hoarding unused reserves that reached more than thirty million strings and bushels of grain.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，行給田募役法，大略如邊郡弓箭手。

translations.literal: In the Xining era they implemented grant-fields hired-corvée law, in general outline like the border circuits' archer corps.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xining reforms they tried grant-fields hired corvée, modeled broadly on frontier archer corps.

sentences.zh: 臣知密州，先募弓手，民甚便之，曾未半年，此法復罷。」

translations.literal: Your subject served as magistrate of Mi Prefecture and first recruited archers — the people found it very convenient; not yet half a year had passed when this law was again abolished."
translations.idiomatic: When I governed Mi Prefecture we first recruited archers; the people welcomed it, yet within half a year the policy was scrapped again."

sentences.zh: 因列其五利。

translations.literal: He thereupon listed its five benefits.
translations.idiomatic: He then set out five advantages of the plan.

sentences.zh: 王岩叟言：「蘇軾乞買田募役，其五利難信，而有十弊。」

translations.literal: Wang Yansou said: "Su Shi begged to buy fields for hired corvée — its five benefits are hard to trust, yet it has ten abuses."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yansou objected: "Su Shi's proposal to buy land for hired corvée — its five claimed benefits are doubtful, and it has ten serious flaws."

sentences.zh: 大指謂：「官市民田，慮不當價；

translations.literal: In general gist he said: "The state buys commoners' fields — fearing unfair price;
translations.idiomatic: In summary he argued: "When the state buys private farmland, prices may be unfair;

sentences.zh: 民受田就募，既非永業，則鹵莽其耕，又將轉而他之。」

translations.literal: commoners receive fields and then answer recruitment — since it is not permanent property, they carelessly farm, and again will transfer elsewhere."
translations.idiomatic: tenants who take land to enlist, holding no permanent title, will farm carelessly and soon abandon the plots."

sentences.zh: 而其六弊特詳，曰：「弓箭手雖名應募，實與家居農民無異，雖或番上及緩急不免點集，實不廢田業，非如州縣色役長在官寺，則弓箭手之擾可知矣。

translations.literal: Yet its sixth abuse he detailed especially, saying: "Archer corps, though named as answering recruitment, in reality are no different from home-dwelling farmers; though sometimes they rotate up and at urgent need cannot avoid roll-call assembly, in reality they do not abandon field enterprises — not like prefecture and county miscellaneous corvée personnel long stationed at government temples; then the archer corps's disturbance can be known.
translations.idiomatic: His sixth objection was the most detailed: "Archers are called recruits but live like ordinary farmers; though they must report for duty in emergencies, they do not abandon their farms — unlike county corvée clerks who live year-round in yamen compounds. Compare that to the lesser burden on archers.

sentences.zh: 然猶聞闕額常難補招，已就招者又時時竄去，引以為比，不切事情。」

translations.literal: Yet it is still heard that vacancy quotas are often hard to replenish through recruitment, and those already recruited also from time to time flee — citing them as comparison does not cut to the matter."
translations.idiomatic: Yet frontier quotas are chronically understaffed and recruits often desert — citing archers as a model misses the point entirely."

sentences.zh: 其七弊曰：「戶及三等以上，皆能自足，必不肯佃田供役。

translations.literal: Its seventh abuse said: "Households reaching third grade and above can all self-suffice — they certainly will not tenant fields to supply corvée.
translations.idiomatic: His seventh flaw: "Third-grade households and above are self-sufficient and will never tenant state land to perform corvée.

sentences.zh: 今立法須二等以上戶方充弓手，三等以上方得供散從官以下色役，乃是用給田募役之名，行揭簿定差之實。

translations.literal: Today's law requires second-grade households and above only to fill archer corps, and third-grade and above only to supply scattered attendants and below miscellaneous corvée — thus using grant-fields hired corvée's name while implementing register-posting fixed assignment's reality.
translations.idiomatic: The new law requires second-grade households for archers and third-grade for scattered attendants and lesser duties — grant-fields hired corvée in name, register-posting assigned corvée in fact.

sentences.zh: 既雲百姓樂於應募，何以戶降四等必須上二等戶保任？

translations.literal: Since it is already said the common people gladly answer recruitment — why, when a household drops to fourth grade, must upper second-grade households guarantee appointment?
translations.idiomatic: If the people truly welcome recruitment, why must fourth-grade households be guaranteed by second-grade neighbors?

sentences.zh: 任之而逃，則勒任者就供田役，此豈得雲樂應也耶？」

translations.literal: If those guaranteed flee, then the guarantors are compelled to go supply field corvée — how can this be called gladly answering?"
translations.idiomatic: If the recruit flees, the guarantor is forced onto the land — what joy is there in that?"

sentences.zh: 上官均亦陳五不可行，軾議遂格。

translations.literal: Shangguan Jun also stated five reasons it could not be implemented; Shi's proposal was then blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Shangguan Jun added five further objections, and Shi's plan was shelved.

sentences.zh: 司馬光復奏：

translations.literal: Sima Guang again memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang memorialized again:

sentences.zh: 「今免役之法，其害有五：上戶舊充役，固有陪備，而得番休，今出錢比舊費特多，年年無休息。

translations.literal: "Today's exemption-from-corvée law has five harms: upper households of old served corvée, naturally had supplementary payments, yet obtained rotation rest — now paying money compared with old expense is especially much, year after year without rest.
translations.idiomatic: "The exemption-from-corvée system has five harms. Wealthy households once served corvée with supplementary payments but enjoyed rotation off duty; now they pay far more in cash, year after year without respite.

sentences.zh: 下戶元不充役，今例使出錢。

translations.literal: Lower households originally did not serve corvée — now by rule all must pay money.
translations.idiomatic: Poor households never served corvée before; now they must all pay cash.

sentences.zh: 舊日所差皆土著良民，今皆浮浪之人應募，無顧藉，受賕，侵陷官物。

translations.literal: Those assigned in old days were all native settled good commoners; now all are floating drifters answering recruitment — without regard for ties, accepting bribes, encroaching on and ruining official goods.
translations.idiomatic: Former assignments went to rooted local householders; now drifters answer recruitment without local ties, take bribes, and mishandle official property.

sentences.zh: 又農民出錢難於出力，若遇凶年，則賣莊田、牛具、桑柘，以錢納官。

translations.literal: Moreover, for farmers paying money is harder than exerting labor; if they meet a bad year, they sell estate fields, oxen and tools, mulberry and catalpa, to pay money to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers find cash harder than labor; in famine years they sell fields, oxen, and mulberry groves to pay the state.

sentences.zh: 提舉常平倉司惟務多斂役錢，廣積寬剩。

translations.literal: Intendant Ever-Normal granary offices only strive to collect much corvée money and broadly accumulate surplus reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Intendant Ever-Normal offices only seek to levy more corvée money and swell surplus reserves.

sentences.zh: 此五害也。

translations.literal: These are the five harms.
translations.idiomatic: Such are the five harms of the system.

sentences.zh: 今莫若直降敕命，盡罷天下免役錢，其諸色役人，並依熙寧元年以前舊法人數，委本縣令佐揭簿定差。

translations.literal: Now nothing is better than directly issuing an edict command, entirely abolishing empire-wide exemption-from-corvée money; all miscellaneous corvée personnel should follow pre-Xining first-year old-law headcounts, entrusted to this county's magistrate and assistants to post registers and fix assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Better to issue an edict abolishing exemption-from-corvée levies empire-wide, restore all corvée posts to pre-Xining quotas, and charge each county magistrate with register-posting assigned corvée.

sentences.zh: 其人不願身自供役，許擇可任者雇代，有逋逃失陷，雇者任之。

translations.literal: If the person is unwilling to supply corvée in person, permit choosing someone capable to hire as substitute; if there is flight, loss, or ruin, the hirer bears responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Those unwilling to serve in person may hire a qualified substitute; the hirer answers for any flight, loss, or default.

sentences.zh: 惟衙前一役，最號重難，固有因而破產者，為此始作助役法。

translations.literal: Only yamen-runner duty is most called heavy and difficult; some have thereby gone bankrupt — for this reason assistance corvée law was first made.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen-runner duty alone is called the hardest; bankruptcies under it prompted the assistance-corvée law in the first place.

sentences.zh: 自後色色優假，禁止陪備，別募命官將校部押遠綱，遂不聞更有破產之人；

translations.literal: Afterward every category received favorable indulgence; supplementary payments were forbidden; separately recruited commissioned officials, generals, and clerks to escort distant transport — thus one no longer heard of more people going bankrupt;
translations.idiomatic: Later every favor was granted, supplementary payments forbidden, and commissioned officers recruited to escort long-distance transport — bankruptcies ceased to be heard of;

sentences.zh: 若今衙前仍行差法，陪備既少，當不至破家。

translations.literal: If now yamen runners still practice assigned method, supplementary payments being few, they should not reach family ruin.
translations.idiomatic: If yamen runners revert to assigned corvée with lighter supplementary payments, households should not be ruined.

sentences.zh: 若猶矜其力難獨任，即乞如舊法，於官戶、寺觀、單丁、女戶有屋產月收僦直可及十五千、莊田中熟所收及百石以上者，並隨貧富以差出助役錢，自餘物產，約此為準。

translations.literal: If still pitying that their strength is hard to bear alone, then beg as in the old law: for official households, temples, single adult males, and female-headed households with house property monthly rent income reaching fifteen thousand, or estate fields mid-harvest yield reaching a hundred bushels and above — all according to rich and poor assign assistance corvée money; for remaining property, approximate by this standard.
translations.idiomatic: If the burden remains too heavy, restore the old assistance levy on official households, temples, single men, and female-headed households with monthly rents of fifteen thousand cash or harvests of a hundred bushels, scaled by wealth, with other property assessed by the same rule.

sentences.zh: 每州樁收，候有重難役使，即以支給。

translations.literal: Each prefecture should stake and collect; when there is heavy difficult corvée service, then disburse from it.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture should stockpile the fund and disburse it when heavy corvée arises.

sentences.zh: 尚慮役人利害，四方不能齊同。

translations.literal: Still fearing corvée personnel's benefits and harms, the four directions cannot be uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Yet corvée conditions differ by region and cannot be uniform everywhere.

sentences.zh: 乞許監司、守令審其可否，可則亟行，如未究盡，縣許五日具措畫上之州，州一月上轉運司，轉運司季以聞。

translations.literal: Beg permission for supervisory commissioners and prefectural magistrates to examine whether it is feasible; if feasible then promptly implement; if not yet fully investigated, counties permitted five days to prepare plans and submit upward to prefectures, prefectures one month upward to transit commissions, transit commissions quarterly to report.
translations.idiomatic: Let supervisory commissioners and prefectural magistrates judge feasibility and act at once where possible; where plans need work, counties may report within five days to the prefecture, prefectures within a month to the transit commission, and transit commissions quarterly to the throne.

sentences.zh: 朝廷委執政審定，隨一路一州各為之敕，務要曲盡。

translations.literal: The court should entrust chief ministers to examine and fix it, following each circuit and prefecture to make edicts for each — striving to exhaust every bend.
translations.idiomatic: Let the chief ministers review and issue tailored edicts for each circuit and prefecture, covering every local circumstance.

sentences.zh: 然免役行之近二十年，富戶習於優利，一旦變更，不能不懷異同。

translations.literal: Yet exemption-from-corvée has been practiced nearly twenty years; wealthy households are accustomed to favorable benefit — suddenly changed, they cannot but harbor mixed feelings.
translations.idiomatic: Exemption-from-corvée has stood nearly twenty years; the wealthy have grown used to its advantages and will resist sudden change.

sentences.zh: 又差役復行，州縣不能不有小擾，提舉官專以多斂役錢為功，必競言免役錢不可罷。

translations.literal: Moreover, with assigned corvée restored, prefectures and counties cannot but have small disturbance; intendant officials specialize in taking much corvée collection as merit — they will certainly compete in saying exemption-from-corvée money cannot be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring assigned corvée will briefly disturb county administration, and intendant officials who built careers on heavy levies will insist exemption fees cannot be abolished.

sentences.zh: 當此之際，願勿以人言輕壞良法。」

translations.literal: At this juncture, I wish you not lightly to ruin a good law because of people's words."
translations.idiomatic: At such a moment, do not lightly abandon a sound law for the sake of clamor."

sentences.zh: 知樞密院章惇取光所奏疏略未盡者駁奏之。

translations.literal: Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhang Dun took Guang's submitted memorial, where the summary was incomplete, and rebutted it in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dun, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, seized on gaps in the summary of Guang's memorial and submitted a rebuttal.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞呂公著言惇專欲求勝，不顧命令大體，望選差近臣詳定。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Lü Gongzhu said Zhang Dun solely seeks victory, heedless of command's great body — hoped to select and assign nearby ministers to examine and fix it in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Lü Gongzhu said Zhang Dun sought only to win the argument without regard for policy, and asked that nearby ministers be appointed to review the matter thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 右正言王覿奏：「光議初上，惇嘗同奏，待既施行，方列光短，其資小人，不當寘腹心地。」

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Official Wang Di memorialized: "When Guang's proposal was first submitted, Dun once memorialized together with it; waiting until it was already implemented, only then listed Guang's shortcomings — his nature is petty man; he ought not be placed in the belly-heart's ground."
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrance Official Wang Di said: "When Guang's plan first came forward, Zhang Dun endorsed it; only after it took effect did he attack Guang's faults — such pettiness should bar him from the inner circle of trust."

sentences.zh: 於是詔以資政殿大學士韓維、給事中範純仁等專切詳定以聞。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered Academician-Excellence of the Hall for Assisting Governance Han Wei, Supervising Secretary Fan Chunren, and others to specialize in thorough examination and report.
translations.idiomatic: The throne then ordered Han Wei, Academician-Excellence, Fan Chunren, Supervising Secretary, and others to conduct a dedicated review and report back.

sentences.zh: 司馬光之始議差役，中書舍人範百祿言於光曰：「熙寧免役法行，百祿為咸平縣，開封罷遣衙前數百人，民皆欣幸。

translations.literal: When Sima Guang first discussed assigned corvée, Central Secretariat drafter Fan Bailu said to Guang: "When the Xining exemption-from-corvée law was implemented, Bailu was magistrate of Xianping County — Kaifeng dismissed several hundred yamen runners, and the people were all joyful.
translations.idiomatic: When Sima Guang first proposed restoring assigned corvée, drafter Fan Bailu told him: "When Xining exemption-from-corvée took effect, I was magistrate of Xianping; Kaifeng released hundreds of yamen runners and the people rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 其後有司求羨餘，務刻剝，乃以法為病。

translations.literal: Afterward responsible offices sought surplus revenue and strove to carve and strip — only then was the law made a disease.
translations.idiomatic: Later offices chased surpluses and squeezed the people — that is what made the law a burden.

sentences.zh: 今第減助免錢額以寬民力可也。」

translations.literal: Now merely reducing assistance and exemption money quotas to broaden the people's strength would suffice."
translations.idiomatic: Now it would be enough simply to cut assistance and exemption levies to ease the people's burden."

sentences.zh: 光雖不從，及議州縣吏因差役受賕從重法加等配流，百祿押刑房，固執不可曰：「鄉民因徭為吏，今日執事而受賕，明日罷役，復以財遺人，若盡以重法繩之，將見黥麵赭衣充塞道路矣。」

translations.literal: Guang though did not follow; when they discussed prefecture and county clerks accepting bribes because of assigned corvée and applying heavy law with added grades and exile assignment, Bailu escorted them to the punishment office and firmly held it could not be done, saying: "Township people become clerks through corvée; today they hold office and accept bribes, tomorrow corvée ends and again they use wealth to give gifts — if all are bound by heavy law, you will see tattooed faces and ochre robes filling the roads."
translations.idiomatic: Guang did not agree; when the court debated sentencing corvée clerks who took bribes to aggravated exile, Bailu blocked the punishment office and insisted: "Villagers become clerks through corvée, take bribes while serving, then bribe others when their term ends — apply the harshest law everywhere and the roads will swarm with tattooed convicts in ochre robes."

sentences.zh: 光曰：「微公言，幾為民害。」

translations.literal: Guang said: "Without your words, I would nearly have harmed the people."
translations.idiomatic: Guang said: "Without your counsel I would nearly have harmed the people."

sentences.zh: 遂已之。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 蘇轍又言：

translations.literal: Su Zhe again spoke:
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhe spoke again:

sentences.zh: 「差役復行，應議者有五：其一曰舊差鄉戶為衙前，破敗人家，甚如兵火。

translations.literal: "Assigned corvée is restored — there are five points that should be discussed: the first says that in old times assigning township households as yamen runners ruined families, very like fire of war.
translations.idiomatic: "Restoring assigned corvée raises five issues. First: drafting township households as yamen runners once ruined families as thoroughly as war.

sentences.zh: 自新法行，天下不復知有衙前之患；

translations.literal: Since the new law was implemented, the empire no longer knew the affliction of yamen runners;
translations.idiomatic: Under the new law the empire forgot the scourge of yamen-runner duty;

sentences.zh: 然而天下反以為苦者，農家歲出役錢為難，及許人添剗見賣坊場，遂有輸納不給者爾。

translations.literal: yet what the empire instead found bitter was farmers' yearly payment of corvée money as hardship, and permitting people to add and scrape ward stalls for visible sale — thus there were those who could not complete payment only.
translations.idiomatic: yet the real hardship was the annual corvée levy on farmers and the permission to bid up ward-stall franchises until some could not pay.

sentences.zh: 向使止用官賣坊場課入以雇衙前，自可足辦，而他色役人止如舊法，則為利較然矣。

translations.literal: If only official sale of ward-stall tax revenue had been used to hire yamen runners, it naturally could have sufficed; other miscellaneous corvée personnel only as in the old law — then the benefit would have been comparatively clear.
translations.idiomatic: Had ward-stall revenue alone hired yamen runners while other corvée followed the old law, the advantage would have been obvious.

sentences.zh: 初疑衙前多是浮浪投雇，不如鄉差稅戶可托。

translations.literal: At first I doubted that yamen runners were mostly floating drifters answering hire — not as trustworthy as township-assigned tax households.
translations.idiomatic: I first doubted hired yamen runners as drifters less trustworthy than assigned tax-paying householders.

sentences.zh: 然行之十餘年，投雇者亦無大敗闕，不足以易鄉差衙前之害。

translations.literal: Yet practiced for more than ten years, those answering hire also had no great failures or gaps — insufficient to exchange for the harm of township-assigned yamen runners.
translations.idiomatic: Yet after more than ten years recruits have not failed badly enough to justify reviving township-assigned yamen runners.

sentences.zh: 今略計天下坊場錢，一歲可得四百二十餘萬貫，若立定中價，不許添剗，三分減一，尚有二百八十餘萬貫。

translations.literal: Now roughly calculating empire-wide ward-stall money, one year can obtain more than 4.2 million strings; if a fixed median price is established, not permitting add-and-scrape, reducing by one-third, there would still be more than 2.8 million strings.
translations.idiomatic: Empire-wide ward-stall revenue now yields over 4.2 million strings a year; fix fair prices, forbid bidding wars, cut a third, and 2.8 million strings would still remain.

sentences.zh: 而衙前支費及召募非泛綱運，一歲共不過一百五十餘萬緡，則是坊場之直，自可了辨衙前百費，何用更差鄉戶？

translations.literal: Yet yamen-runner disbursements and recruitment for non-routine transport together in one year do not exceed more than 1.5 million strings — then ward-stall's worth naturally can settle all yamen-runner hundred expenses; why need further assign township households?
translations.idiomatic: Yamen-runner costs and non-routine transport recruitment total under 1.5 million strings a year — ward-stall revenue alone could cover every yamen-runner expense; why draft township households again?

sentences.zh: 今制盡復差役，知衙前若無陪備，故以鄉戶為之；

translations.literal: Today's system entirely restores assigned corvée, knowing that if yamen runners have no supplementary payments, therefore township households are used for it;
translations.idiomatic: The new policy restores assigned corvée entirely, assuming township households are needed because yamen runners lack supplementary payments;

sentences.zh: 至於坊場，元無明降處分，不知官自出賣耶，抑仍用以酬獎衙前也？

translations.literal: As for ward stalls, originally there was no clear descending disposition — it is not known whether the state itself will sell them, or still use them to reward and compensate yamen runners?
translations.idiomatic: Yet no clear order governs ward stalls — will the state sell them directly or still use the revenue to compensate yamen runners?

sentences.zh: 若仍用以酬獎，即召募部綱以何錢應用？

translations.literal: If still used to reward and compensate, then recruiting escorts for transport — with what money should it be applied?
translations.idiomatic: If revenue still compensates yamen runners, what funds will recruit transport escorts?

sentences.zh: 若不與之錢，即舊名重難，鄉戶衙前仍前自備，為害不小。

translations.literal: If money is not given them, then the old name of heavy difficulty — township-household yamen runners still as before self-provide — the harm is not small.
translations.idiomatic: Without cash compensation the old heavy-duty yamen-runner burden returns, and township householders must again bear costs themselves — no small harm.

sentences.zh: 其二，坊郭人戶舊苦科配，新法令與鄉戶並出役錢，而免科配，其法甚便。

translations.literal: Second: urban ward households of old suffered categorized assignments; the new law ordered them together with township households to pay corvée money while exempting categorized assignment — the law was very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Second: urban households once suffered arbitrary levies; the new law had them pay corvée money alongside rural households in exchange for ending those levies — a sound arrangement.

sentences.zh: 但敷錢大重，未為經久之法。

translations.literal: But spreading money was too heavy — not yet a long-lasting law.
translations.idiomatic: But the levies were too heavy to be sustainable.

sentences.zh: 乞取坊郭、官戶、寺觀、單丁、女戶，酌今役錢減定中數，與坊場錢用以支雇衙前及召募非泛綱運外，卻令樁備募雇諸色役人之用。

translations.literal: Beg to take urban wards, official households, temples, single adult males, and female-headed households, weigh present corvée money and reduce to fix a median number; together with ward-stall money used to pay hiring yamen runners and recruiting non-routine transport, besides that order staked reserve for hiring miscellaneous corvée personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Levy urban wards, official households, temples, single men, and female-headed households at a reduced median rate; use ward-stall revenue to hire yamen runners and non-routine transport, and stockpile the rest for hiring other corvée posts.

sentences.zh: 其三，乞用見今在役人數定差，熙寧未減定前，其數實冗，不可遵用。

translations.literal: Third: beg to use present in-service headcounts to fix assignment; before Xining reduction and fixing, the numbers were truly redundant — cannot be followed and used.
translations.idiomatic: Third: fix assignments from current in-service quotas, not the bloated pre-Xining rolls.

sentences.zh: 其四，熙寧以前，散從、弓手、手力諸役人常苦逆送，自新法以來，官吏皆請雇錢，役人既便，官亦不至闕事，乞仍用雇法。

translations.literal: Fourth: before Xining, scattered attendants, archers, hand laborers, and other corvée personnel often suffered escort duty; since the new law, officials all request hire money — corvée personnel are already convenient, and officials also do not reach shortfall in affairs; beg still to use hire method.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: before Xining scattered attendants, archers, and hand laborers dreaded escort duty; under the new law officials pay hire wages, easing both corvée workers and administration — keep hired corvée.

sentences.zh: 其五，州縣胥吏並量支雇錢募充，仍罷重法，亦許以坊場、坊郭錢為用；

translations.literal: Fifth: prefecture and county clerks should all according to measure disburse hire money to recruit and fill posts, still abolish heavy law, also permit using ward-stall and urban ward money;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: fund county clerks through measured hire wages, repeal harsh penalties, and draw on ward-stall and urban revenue;

sentences.zh: 不足用，方差鄉戶，鄉戶所出雇錢，不得過官雇本數。」

translations.literal: if insufficient, only then assign township households; hire money paid by township households must not exceed the state's hire principal number."
translations.idiomatic: and only if funds fall short assign township households, whose hire payments must not exceed the official rate."

sentences.zh: 詔送看詳役法所詳定，擇其要者先奏以行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered it sent to the office examining corvée law in detail for detailed fixing; select the essential points and first memorialize for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the proposal to the corvée-law review office and ordered the main points implemented first.

sentences.zh: 於是役人悉用見數為額，惟衙前用坊場、河渡錢雇募，不足，方許揭簿定差。

translations.literal: Thereupon corvée personnel all used present numbers as quota; only yamen runners used ward-stall and ferry-crossing money for hire and recruitment — if insufficient, only then was register posting and fixed assignment permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée quotas were set from current headcounts; yamen runners alone were hired from ward-stall and ferry revenues, with register-posting assigned corvée only when funds fell short.

sentences.zh: 其餘役人，惟該募者得募，餘悉定差。

translations.literal: The remaining corvée personnel — only those eligible for recruitment might be recruited; the rest were all fixed by assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Other corvée posts could be hired only where recruitment applied; all others were assigned.

sentences.zh: 遂罷官戶、寺觀、單丁、女戶出助役法，其今夏役錢即免輸。

translations.literal: Thereupon assistance corvée law for official households, temples, single adult males, and female-headed households was abolished; their summer corvée money for this year was immediately exempted from payment.
translations.idiomatic: Assistance levies on official households, temples, single men, and female-headed households were abolished, and their summer corvée payments were waived for that year.

sentences.zh: 尋以衙前不皆有雇直，遂改雇募為招募。

translations.literal: Soon, because yamen runners did not all have hire wages, hire and recruitment was changed to open recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because not every yamen-runner post had a hire wage, hired corvée was renamed open recruitment.

sentences.zh: 凡熙、豐嘗立法禁以衙前及役人非理役使及令陪備圓融之類，悉申行之，耆壯依保正長法。

translations.literal: All Xining and Fengning laws once made forbidding unreasonable service of yamen runners and corvée personnel, ordering supplementary payments and round-about accommodation, and the like — all were re-applied; elders and stalwart youth followed security-captain and head-of-ten law.
translations.idiomatic: All Xining and Yuanfeng prohibitions on abusive use of yamen runners and corvée workers, forced supplementary payments, and similar abuses were re-enforced; elders and stalwart youth followed the security-captain system.

sentences.zh: 坊場河渡錢、量添酒錢之類，名色不一，惟於法許用者支用外，並樁備招募衙前、支酬重難及應緣役事之用。

translations.literal: Ward-stall money, ferry-crossing money, measured added wine money, and the like — names and categories not uniform; apart from disbursements permitted by law, all were staked and reserved for recruiting yamen runners, paying heavy-difficulty compensation, and corvée matters that should follow.
translations.idiomatic: Ward-stall revenue, ferry fees, added wine taxes, and similar funds were to be spent only as law allowed; the remainder stockpiled to recruit yamen runners, pay heavy-duty compensation, and meet related corvée needs.

sentences.zh: 如一州錢不供用，許移別州錢用之，一路不足，許從戶部通他路移用；

translations.literal: If one prefecture's money was insufficient for use, transfer from another prefecture's money was permitted; if one circuit was insufficient, transfer through the Household Ministry across other circuits was permitted;
translations.idiomatic: A prefecture short of funds might draw from another prefecture; a circuit short might draw through the Household Ministry from other circuits;

sentences.zh: 其或有餘，毋得妄用，其或不足，毋得減募增置。

translations.literal: if there was surplus, it must not be rashly used; if there was insufficiency, recruitment must not be reduced or posts increased.
translations.idiomatic: surplus must not be spent recklessly, nor shortages met by cutting recruitment or adding posts.

sentences.zh: 衙前最為重役，若已招募足額，上一等戶有虛閑不差者，令供次等色役。

translations.literal: Yamen-runner duty is the heaviest corvée; if recruitment already fills the quota, upper-grade households with idle vacancy not assigned should be ordered to supply lower-grade miscellaneous corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen-runner duty was the heaviest; once recruitment met quota, idle top-grade households were assigned lesser corvée duties.

sentences.zh: 鄉差役人，在職官如敢抑令別雇承符、散從承代其役者，轉運司劾奏重責。
