translations.literal: For township-assigned corvée personnel, if incumbent officials dared to coerce them into separately hiring notice bearers or scattered attendants to substitute for their corvée, the transit commission would impeach and memorialize heavy punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who forced assigned corvée workers to hire notice bearers or scattered attendants as substitutes would face impeachment and heavy penalties from the transit commission.

sentences.zh: 時提舉常平司已罷置，凡役事改隸提刑司。

translations.literal: At that time intendant Ever-Normal offices had already been abolished and disbanded; all corvée affairs were changed to be subordinate to judicial intendant offices.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Ever-Normal intendant offices had been abolished and all corvée affairs transferred to judicial intendant offices.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史呂陶言：「天下版籍不齊，或以稅錢貫百，或以田地頃畝，或以家之積財，或以田之受種。

translations.literal: Palace attendant censor Lü Tao said: "Empire-wide household registers are not uniform — some by tax money in strings of hundreds, some by field area in qing and mu, some by household accumulated wealth, some by field seed received.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant censor Lü Tao said: "Household registers differ empire-wide — some rank by tax strings, some by acreage, some by family wealth, some by seed yield.

sentences.zh: 雖皆別為五等，然有稅錢一貫、占田一頃、積財千緡、受種十石而入之一等。

translations.literal: Although all are separately divided into five grades, yet there are those with one string of tax money, one qing of occupied field, a thousand strings of accumulated wealth, or ten bushels of seed received who enter the first grade.
translations.idiomatic: All are divided into five grades, yet one string of tax, one qing of land, a thousand strings of wealth, or ten bushels of yield can place a household in the first grade.

sentences.zh: 一等之上，無等可加，遂至稅緡、田頃、積財、受種十倍於此，亦不過同在一等。

translations.literal: Above the first grade there is no grade that can be added — thus even when tax strings, field qing, accumulated wealth, and seed received are ten times this, they still do not exceed sharing the same first grade.
translations.idiomatic: Above the first grade no higher rank exists — households paying ten times the tax, holding ten times the land, wealth, or yield still share the same top grade.

sentences.zh: 憑此差役，必不均平。

translations.literal: Relying on this for assigned corvée, it certainly cannot be even and level.
translations.idiomatic: Assigned corvée on this basis cannot be fair.

sentences.zh: 雖無今日納錢之勞，反有昔時偏頗陪費之害。

translations.literal: Although without today's labor of paying money, instead there is the old harm of biased partial supplementary payments.
translations.idiomatic: Though cash levies would end, the old harm of uneven supplementary payments would return.

sentences.zh: 莫若裁量新舊，著為條約：如稅錢一貫為第一等，合於本等中差一役，稅錢兩倍於一役者並差二役，又倍即差三役；

translations.literal: Better to weigh new and old and set it as a covenant: for example, one string of tax money as first grade — fitting within this grade assign one corvée; tax money twice that of one corvée assigns two corvées together; again doubled then assigns three corvées;
translations.idiomatic: Better to blend old and new in a fixed rule: one string of tax marks the first grade and one corvée assignment; double that tax assigns two corvées; double again assigns three;

sentences.zh: 雖稅錢更多，不過三役，並聽雇人。

translations.literal: although tax money is more, not exceeding three corvées — all permitted to hire persons.
translations.idiomatic: however high the tax, no more than three corvées, each fillable by hire.

sentences.zh: 或本縣戶多役少，則上戶之役不須並差，但可次敘休役年月遠近而均其勞逸。

translations.literal: Or if in a county households are many but corvée assignments few, then upper households' corvée need not all be assigned together; one may only sequence rest-from-corvée years near and far to equalize labor and ease.
translations.idiomatic: Where a county has many households but light corvée quotas, upper households need not all serve at once; rest years can be sequenced according to tax liability so that labor and relief are balanced fairly.

sentences.zh: 假令甲充役後可閑五年，乙稅錢兩倍於甲，可閑三年，丙又倍於乙，可閑一年。

translations.literal: Suppose after serving corvée A may rest five years; B's tax money is twice A's and may rest three years; C is again twice B and may rest one year.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose Household A, after serving, rests five years; Household B, paying twice A's taxes, rests three years; Household C, paying twice B's taxes, rests one year.

sentences.zh: 以其田土頃畝之類為等並其餘同等多少不侔者，並仿此。

translations.literal: Using their fields' qing and mu and the like as grades, together with others of the same grade whose amounts are unequal — all follow this model.
translations.idiomatic: The same principle applies when ranking by acreage or when households of the same nominal grade differ widely in wealth.

sentences.zh: 又成、梓兩路差役，舊專以戶稅為差等，熙寧初，別定坊郭戶營運錢以助免役。

translations.literal: Moreover in Chengdu and Zizhou circuits corvée assignments formerly relied solely on household tax for grades; at the beginning of Xining, urban ward households' operating money was separately fixed to assist exemption-from-corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chengdu and Zizhou circuits, corvée ranks had long been based solely on household tax. Early in Xining, urban households were additionally assessed operating capital levies to support the exemption-from-corvée system.

sentences.zh: 乃在稅產之外，州縣抑認成額，至今不減，至有停閑居業移避鄉村，猶不得免。

translations.literal: This lay beyond taxed property; prefectures and counties forcibly recognized fixed quotas, still not reduced to this day — even those who ceased business and moved to villages to avoid it still could not be exempted.
translations.idiomatic: These levies stood outside assessed property. Prefectures and counties enforced fixed quotas that remain unrevised. Some merchants shut their shops and moved to the countryside to escape them, yet still could not obtain exemption.

sentences.zh: 今方議法，坊郭等第固不可偏廢，然須參究虛實，別行排定，以寬民力。」

translations.literal: Now while deliberating law, urban ward grades indeed cannot be one-sidedly abandoned; yet it is necessary to investigate truth and falsehood, separately carry out reassessment, to ease the people's strength."
translations.idiomatic: As the law is being revised, urban household grades cannot simply be abolished, but their assessments must be audited and reset to ease the people's burdens."

sentences.zh: 並送詳定所。

translations.literal: All were sent to the detailed deliberation office.
translations.idiomatic: These proposals were referred to the review office.

sentences.zh: 蘇轍又言：「雇募衙前改為招募，既非明以錢雇，必無肯就招者，勢須差撥，不知歲收坊場、河渡緡錢四百二十餘萬，欲於何地用之？

translations.literal: Su Zhe also said: "Changing hired-recruitment yamen runners to open recruitment — since it is not clearly hiring with money, there will certainly be none willing to accept recruitment; the situation will require assignment and dispatch. I do not know the yearly collection of franchise and ferry-crossing money of more than 4.2 million strings — where is it intended to be used?
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhe added: "Renaming hired yamen runners as 'recruits' without openly paying wages will leave no volunteers; counties will assign corvée in disguise. Meanwhile more than 4.2 million strings are collected yearly from franchises and ferry tolls — for what purpose?

sentences.zh: 熙寧以前，諸路衙前多雇長名當役，如西川全是長名，淮南、兩浙長名太半以上，餘路亦不減半。

translations.literal: Before Xining, yamen runners in all circuits mostly hired long-registered persons to serve; as in Sichuan entirely long-registered, Huainan and the two Zhe more than half long-registered, other circuits also not less than half.
translations.idiomatic: Before Xining, most circuits filled yamen-runner posts with long-registered men. Sichuan used them exclusively; Huainan and the two Zhe circuits used them for more than half of all posts; other circuits used them for at least half.

sentences.zh: 今坊場官既自賣，必無願充長名，則衙前並是鄉戶。

translations.literal: Now that franchises are sold by officials themselves, there will certainly be none willing to fill long-registered posts — then yamen runners will all be township households.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the government sells franchises directly, no one will take long-registered posts, and yamen runners will again be drawn from township households.

sentences.zh: 雖號招募，而上戶利於免役，方肯占名，與差無異。

translations.literal: Although called recruitment, upper households profit from exemption-from-corvée and only then are willing to register their names — no different from assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Though called recruitment, only upper households who benefit from exemption fees will register — which is assignment in all but name.

sentences.zh: 上戶既免衙前重役，則凡役皆當均及以次人戶，如此則下戶充役，多如熙寧前矣。」

translations.literal: Once upper households are exempt from heavy yamen-runner corvée, then all corvée ought to be spread evenly to lower-ranked households — thus lower households filling corvée will be as numerous as before Xining."
translations.idiomatic: If upper households escape the heaviest yamen-runner duties, every other corvée will fall on lower-ranked households, and lower households will bear corvée as heavily as they did before Xining."
